Ecology: Vespiquen live in hives of Combee that work in the hive together. It eats food brought to it by Combee workers, releasing pheremones to make sure the Combee in its hive keep working. They are very commanding Pokémon.

Name: Pachirisu
Ecology: Pachirisu are found in forests. It makes nests in the holes of trees or under the eaves of houses. They create a ball of fur that they share to stay warm. These squirrel Pokémon often live in groups and use static electricity to confuse enemies.

Name: Buizel
Ecology: Buizel live in bodies of water. They swim by spinning their two tails like a screw, and will travel out of water to forage for berries. The floatation sac it has will help it get back to shore if it becomes tired while in the water. Buizel are often solitary and active.

Name: Floatzel

Name: Cherubi
Ecology: Cherubi are solitary Pokémon that inhabit forests and orchards. They get nutrients from the sun by extracting it into the ball on its head. When this Pokemon gets all the nutrients it needs, the ball separates into a different, evolved Pokémon. Cherubi are generally quiet Pokémon.

Name: Cherrim
Ecology: Cherrim are often found in grassy areas or meadows with plenty of sunlight. When it rains, they will hide under large leaves to protect themselves. They are solitary Pokémon.

Name: Shellos
Ecology: Shellos lives on beaches and sea floors. These Pokémon eats floating seaweed that washes up on shore, and they can be found in small groups.

Name: Gastrodon

Name: Ambipom

Name: Drifloon

Name: Drifblim

Name: Buneary

Name: Lopunny

Name: Mismagius

Name: Honchkrow

Name: Glameow

Name: Purugly
Ecology: Purugly prefers dark and dirty environments. It lives and sleeps wherever it is most convenient to do so. These Pokemon are solitary.

Name: Chingling
Ecology: Chingling are found in caves and plains. They are mostly solitary creatures.

Name: Stunky

Name: Skuntank

Name: Bronzor

Name: Bronzong

Name: Bonsly

Name: Mime-jr

They live in small groups, communicating through mime-like gestures, their behavior mimicring other's emotions..

Name: Happiny

Name: Chatot
Ecology: Chatot lives in tropical forests and jungles, imitating human speech and other Pokémon sounds. They primarily eat fruit and seeds, mimicking sounds to locate food sources. Chatot can form flocks, communicating through mimicking noises, often disrupting the areas where they are present.

Name: Spiritomb
Ecology: Spiritomb are said to reside in ancient ruins and cursed locations. These Pokémon absorb the souls of others, typically malicious or revengeful people that caused damage to those around them. Spiritomb is solitary, and feeds on the energy it gets from souls of people, which is said to keep the cycle of souls at ease.

Name: Gible
Ecology: Gible typically lives in caves and underground tunnels in rocky terrain. Gible feeds on rocks, minerals, and any small animals it can catch in the tunnels. They are solitary creatures until they mature. They dig into the ground to nest, showing their head above the surface.

Name: Gabite

Name: Garchomp
Ecology: Garchomp are found in rugged terrain, soaring above canyons. It preys on ground based Pokemon. Garchomp are fiercely protective of their territory and young.

Name: Munchlax
Ecology: Munchlax inhabits forests and grasslands. Its diet mainly consists of berries, fruits, and seeds, storing food in its fur. They are solitary foragers, wandering great distances in search of sustenance and are known for their easygoing nature and fondness for napping.

Name: Riolu
Ecology: Riolu lives in mountainous regions, honing their aura-sensing abilities through intense training. Riolu sustain on berries and absorb energy from sunlight, constantly training. These Pokémon often form small groups, learning from a wise master in the clan.

Name: Lucario
Ecology: Lucario live in remote mountain peaks. They feed on forest wildlife and hunt in packs. Lucario are extremely vigilant. They communicate through complex Aura sensing to determine friend or foe, often defending a village.

Name: Hippopotas
Ecology: Hippopotas burrows and lives in desert environments. Hippopotas has tough skin that insulates them. Hippopotas are solitary Pokémon, rarely interacting with others of its kind except during mating season and defends their young until maturation.

Name: Hippowdon
Ecology: Hippowdon can be found in arid regions. This Pokemon defends its territory viciously by sending sand into its enemy's eyes. Typically lives in packs but has to be challenged to take leadership of a group.

Name: Skorupi
Ecology: Skorupi are often found in marshy areas or dense forests. They are nocturnal hunters, feeding on small insects and occasionally small rodents. They are solitary creatures, preferring to hunt alone, and tend to be cautious and somewhat timid, often retreating when faced with larger predators. Their personality can be described as cautious and reserved.

Name: Drapion
Ecology: Drapion inhabit arid and rocky terrains, where they can ambush prey from underground tunnels. These Pokémon are carnivorous, preying on smaller Pokémon and consuming anything they can overpower with their massive claws. Drapion are territorial and typically solitary, exhibiting aggressive behavior to protect their domain. They are known for their ruthless and tenacious personality, rarely backing down from a challenge.

Name: Croagunk
Ecology: Croagunk live in swamps and other humid environments. They have a varied diet, eating insects, berries, and whatever else they can find. Croagunk are semi-social, often congregating near water sources but still maintaining individual territories. Known for their mischievous and opportunistic personality, they often startle other Pokémon with their poisonous touch.

Name: Toxicroak
Ecology: Toxicroak favor swampy and humid areas. They are carnivorous and are known to hunt using the poisonous sacs on their wrists. Toxicroak are fiercely territorial, often seen leading small packs, and are incredibly aggressive. They are notorious for their battle-hungry personality, and enjoy testing their strength against any challenger.

Name: Carnivine
Ecology: Carnivine inhabits dense forests and jungles, often camouflaged among vines. They are carnivorous Pokémon, luring prey with their sweet-smelling saliva before trapping them in their large mouth. Carnivine is a solitary Pokémon, hanging from tree branches, and is incredibly patient. Its personality is best described as ambush predator: waiting and watchful.

Name: Finneon
Ecology: Finneon live in deep ocean environments and are attracted to well-lit areas. They eat small plankton and microorganisms. Finneon are schooling fish, living in groups, and their vibrant colors attract other members of the school. These Pokémon are known for their peaceful and timid nature, and they tend to flee from conflict.

Name: Lumineon
Ecology: Lumineon inhabit the deep sea, near the ocean floor, typically congregating near areas with hydrothermal vents. Lumineon primarily feed on small fish and plankton, using their fins to attract prey. They form small schools in the dark depths. Lumineon exhibit a calm and gentle personality, often used in underwater light shows for their radiant appearance.

Name: Mantyke
Ecology: Mantyke often live in warm, shallow seas and coastal areas. They primarily feed on plankton, which they filter from the water. Mantyke are social Pokémon and tend to travel in groups, often accompanied by a Remoraid. Known for their gentle and playful demeanor, they enjoy performing aerial acrobatics over the water's surface.

Name: Snover
Ecology: Snover resides in snowy mountains and frigid forests. Snover feeds on berries that grow among the snowy landscape, often buried beneath the snow. These Pokémon are typically solitary but can be found in small groups in protected groves. Snover tends to be shy and quiet, and they possess a calm personality adapted for surviving the cold.

Name: Abomasnow
Ecology: Abomasnow live high on snowy mountains, where it is bitterly cold year-round. They feed on tree bark and the few resilient plants that can withstand the harsh environment. Abomasnow are solitary and territorial Pokémon. Abomasnow has a grumpy and brooding personality due to its life in isolation.

Name: Weavile
Ecology: Weavile typically live in snowy, mountainous regions, often near human settlements. They are opportunistic omnivores, eating both small animals and berries. Weavile often form small packs led by an alpha. Known for their cunning and sneaky personalities, Weavile are known for their collaborative hunting strategies and coordinated attacks.

Name: Magnezone
Ecology: Magnezone are found in areas with strong magnetic fields, such as power plants or mountainous regions with mineral deposits. They are believed to subsist on electricity, absorbing energy from the environment. Magnezone gather in groups to amplify their magnetic powers, creating unusual atmospheric phenomena. Known for their methodical and calculating personalities, Magnezone approach problems with analytical precision.

Name: Lickilicky
Ecology: Lickilicky are usually found near grassy plains and forests, often near bodies of water. They have an indiscriminate diet, licking up anything that appears remotely edible with their long tongues. Lickilicky tend to be solitary but aren't aggressive, often ignoring others nearby. Their curious and relaxed demeanor makes them a relatively peaceful, if somewhat aloof, presence.

Name: Rhyperior
Ecology: Rhyperior primarily inhabit rocky terrains, from caves to volcanic mountains. They consume rocks and minerals for sustenance and to strengthen their armor. Rhyperior are solitary Pokémon. Rhyperior are very protective and have an explosive temper when provoked. They can be both defensive and destructive.

Name: Tangrowth
Ecology: Tangrowth reside in dense jungles and overgrown areas, where their vine-like bodies allow them to move and blend seamlessly with the environment. They photosynthesize for food. Tangrowth are usually solitary. Tangrowth have a gentle and playful nature. They are shy, preferring to wrap themselves with their vines when startled.

Name: Electivire
Ecology: Electivire typically inhabit power plants and areas with strong electrical activity. They feed on electricity and are often solitary, preferring to live and hunt alone. Electivire are known for their aggressive nature and are often seen battling other Electric-type Pokémon for territory.

Name: Magmortar
Ecology: Magmortar reside in volcanic regions and areas with intense heat. They consume molten rocks and other fiery substances for sustenance. Magmortar are solitary creatures with a fiery temper and are known to fiercely protect their territory.

Name: Togekiss
Ecology: Togekiss inhabit lush forests and mountaintops where the air is clean and pure. They feed on berries and nectar and are known for their gentle and peaceful nature. Togekiss are social creatures, often living in small flocks and are believed to bring good luck to those they encounter.

Name: Yanmega
Ecology: Yanmega thrive in swamps, marshes, and other wetland environments. They hunt smaller insects and other invertebrates, using their sharp mandibles to capture prey. Yanmega are often solitary hunters, patrolling their territories with speed and precision. They are known for their territorial behavior and will aggressively defend their hunting grounds.

Name: Leafeon
Ecology: Leafeon typically live in lush forests and meadows, where they absorb sunlight for sustenance through photosynthesis. They have a diet consisting mainly of sunlight and fresh water. Leafeon are solitary creatures, preferring to live in secluded areas where they can peacefully bask in the sun. They are known for their gentle nature and close connection to nature.

Name: Glaceon
Ecology: Glaceon inhabit icy caves and frozen environments, thriving in cold temperatures. They obtain nourishment by absorbing heat from the environment and can freeze the surrounding air to create ice crystals. Glaceon are solitary creatures, preferring to live in isolation within their icy habitats. They are known for their calm and serene demeanor.

Name: Gliscor
Ecology: Gliscor inhabit rocky cliffs and caves, often living in arid or semi-arid environments. They are nocturnal hunters, feeding on insects, small mammals, and fruits. Gliscor are solitary creatures, preferring to hunt and live alone. They are known for their territorial behavior and will fiercely defend their hunting grounds.

Name: Mamoswine
Ecology: Mamoswine thrive in frigid, icy environments. They have thick fur that protects them from the cold and use their tusks to dig through snow for food. They consume roots, berries, and other vegetation found beneath the snow. Mamoswine typically live in herds and are known for their gentle nature despite their large size.

Name: Porygon-z
Ecology: Porygon-Z are typically found in virtual environments, such as computer networks and digital landscapes. They consume data and information, using their advanced programming to process and analyze vast amounts of data. Porygon-Z are solitary creatures, preferring to explore and learn within the digital realm. They are known for their curious and inquisitive nature.

Name: Gallade
Ecology: Gallade often inhabit mountainous regions and forests, where they train and hone their skills. They consume fruits, berries, and small insects for sustenance. Gallade are solitary Pokémon, typically living and training alone to perfect their swordsmanship. They are known for their strong sense of justice and unwavering loyalty.

Name: Probopass
Ecology: Probopass reside in caves, mines, and areas with strong magnetic fields. They consume iron-rich rocks and minerals, using their magnetic abilities to attract and manipulate these resources. Probopass live in small groups, often led by an older, more experienced individual. They are known for their territorial nature and will defend their home against intruders.

Name: Dusknoir
Ecology: Dusknoir are said to inhabit dark and abandoned places, such as old buildings, ruins, and cemeteries. They are believed to guide lost spirits to the afterlife and consume the wandering souls of the deceased. Dusknoir are typically solitary creatures, lurking in the shadows and silently observing the world around them. They are known for their mysterious and ominous presence.

Name: Froslass
Ecology: Froslass live in snowy mountain regions and are said to be the spirits of women who got lost in the snow. They feed on the life force of humans and Pokémon, freezing them with their breath. They are solitary creatures, known for their haunting beauty and ability to create illusions to lure their victims.

Name: Rotom
Ecology: Rotom have no specific habitat, as they are able to inhabit various electrical appliances. They feed on electricity and can alter the function of the appliances they possess. They are often solitary, and while their personalities can vary, they are known for being mischievous and curious, sometimes causing trouble when possessing electronics.

Name: Uxie
Ecology: Uxie lives in caves and is known to reside in Acuity Cavern in the Sinnoh region. Being one of the Lake Guardians, Uxie does not typically seek out a food source, and it's more focused on keeping its mental abilities at peak performance, often meditating. Uxie is very solitary, and very rarely appears before humans.

Name: Mesprit
Ecology: Mesprit is said to live at the bottom of Lake Verity, embodying emotion.  It's a solitary Pokémon, rarely seen by humans.  It is believed to balance emotions within those nearby.

Name: Azelf
Ecology: Azelf dwells at the bottom of Lake Valor and embodies willpower. It prefers solitude and is rarely seen by humans. It is believed to grant humans the will to overcome challenges.

Name: Dialga
Ecology: Dialga lives in a different dimension, and controls the flow of time. When Dialga's heart beats, time is said to flow. Its habitat is unknown, as it exists outside of our perception of time and space.  It is solitary, and often found in areas of temporal distortion.

Name: Palkia
Ecology: Palkia is said to live in a different dimension. It has the ability to distort space.  When Palkia breathes, space is believed to become more stable.  Its habitat is in an alternate dimension, often appearing where spatial distortions are strongest. It's a solitary Pokémon.

Name: Heatran
Ecology: Heatran dwells in volcanic caves and areas near magma flows. It is known for its aggressive and territorial nature. They are solitary creatures, constantly seeking out sources of heat and molten rock to sustain their fiery bodies. They feed on minerals and geothermal energy.

Name: Regigigas
Ecology: Regigigas is said to have created the Legendary Titans (Regirock, Regice, Registeel). Regigigas is typically dormant, awakening only when a significant event occurs.  It dwells in ancient ruins.  It is a solitary creature.

Name: Giratina-altered
Ecology: Giratina, in its Altered Forme, dwells in the Distortion World, a dimension parallel to our own. It is believed to maintain the balance between dimensions. Giratina is an aggressive and solitary Pokémon, constantly seeking to stabilize its unstable home.

Name: Cresselia
Ecology: Cresselia constantly flies around the world, seeking to soothe nightmares. When Cresselia flaps its wings, it releases shimmering particles. Those particles are said to bring restful dreams to those who touch them. It is a solitary Pokémon that can be found near islands.

Name: Phione
Ecology: Phione are often seen drifting in warm seas. They form groups and float together in the ocean's currents, feeding on seaweed and plankton.  It's a social Pokémon.

Name: Manaphy
Ecology: Manaphy are born in cold seas.  They journey great distances to return to their place of birth. Manaphy is able to bond with any kind of Pokémon. Manaphy tend to travel alone, and feed off small shellfish.

Name: Darkrai
Ecology: Darkrai haunts the dreams of others, inflicting nightmares. To protect itself, it induces endless nightmares in anyone who approaches its location.  Darkrai lives in a darkened forest on a crescent moon-shaped island.  It's a solitary creature.

Name: Shaymin-land
Ecology: Shaymin lives in flower patches and grasslands, absorbing pollutants to transform them into flowers. It migrates when the flowers of the Gracidea key bloom, following the wind. Shaymin travels in packs, blooming flowers where they walk. They feed on sunlight and rainwater.

Name: Arceus
Ecology: Arceus is said to have shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms. Arceus appears where it senses genuine respect and gratitude. It is said that it dwells in the Hall of Origin, high above Sinnoh, beyond Mount Coronet.  It lives alone, and appears where it senses genuine respect and gratitude.

Name: Victini
Ecology: Victini is said to bring victory to trainers. It shares the infinite energy it creates. Victini is thought to appear in places where great ambitions are held. It nests in special energy spots, and is generally solitary.

Name: Snivy
Ecology: Snivy prefer sunny environments. They're highly intelligent, cautious Pokémon. A Snivy basks in the sun. But when it gets dirty, it uses the leaves on its tail to absorb light and clean itself.  Snivy are generally solitary, and primarily consume sunlight.

Name: Servine
Ecology: Servine primarily inhabits lush forests and grasslands. They are typically solitary Pokémon, gracefully moving through the undergrowth in search of sunlight and moisture. Their diet mainly consists of berries and leaves, which they carefully select for optimal nutrition. Servine possess a calm and collected demeanor, often basking in the sun to conserve energy.

Name: Serperior
Ecology: Serperior are found in dense, old-growth forests, where they reign as elegant and powerful Pokémon. They are solitary creatures, rarely seen in groups, preferring to establish their own territory. Serperior feed on high-energy fruits and the occasional small Pokémon, exhibiting a regal and composed personality, always maintaining a graceful posture.

Name: Tepig
Ecology: Tepig lives in warm, grassy areas, often near human settlements. They are social creatures, living in small groups or families. Tepig are omnivorous, eating berries, nuts, and occasionally scavenging for discarded food. They have a cheerful and playful personality, often emitting puffs of smoke from their snouts when excited.

Name: Pignite
Ecology: Pignite dwells in volcanic regions or areas with hot springs, where they can wallow in the warmth. They live in small packs, relying on each other for protection. Pignite are omnivorous, feeding on roasted berries and occasionally hunting for prey using their fiery attacks. These Pokémon are known for their short temper and love of battling.

Name: Emboar
Ecology: Emboar inhabits mountainous regions with active volcanoes. They are solitary Pokémon that mark their territory with fire. Emboar are omnivorous, eating charred fruits, plants, and larger prey they defeat in combat. Emboar display a strong sense of loyalty and are fiercely protective of their friends and family.

Name: Oshawott
Ecology: Oshawott resides along coastlines and freshwater rivers. They live in small, closely-knit groups and are adept swimmers and hunters. Oshawott are carnivorous, consuming primarily shellfish, which they crack open with their scalchop. They are playful and curious Pokémon, known for their eagerness to learn new skills.

Name: Dewott
Ecology: Dewott lives near bodies of water like lakes, rivers, and the ocean. They often form small training groups and practice swordsmanship with their scalchops. Dewott are carnivorous and hunt for fish and shellfish, exhibiting a disciplined and focused personality, always striving to improve their skills.

Name: Samurott
Ecology: Samurott inhabit coastal regions and secluded islands. They are typically solitary Pokémon that establish territories along the shore. Samurott are carnivorous, consuming large fish and sea creatures which they hunt with precision. Known for their strong sense of honor and leadership, Samurott are respected by other Pokémon.

Name: Patrat
Ecology: Patrat are found in grassy fields and urban environments, living in groups led by a Watchog. They act as scouts, warning the group of any potential danger. Patrat are primarily herbivorous, consuming seeds and berries, and are known for being cautious and alert, always on the lookout for threats.

Name: Watchog
Ecology: Watchog live in grassy plains and caves, acting as leaders for groups of Patrat. They watch over their territory and warn others of danger. Watchog are omnivorous, eating both plants and insects, possessing a vigilant and responsible personality, always prioritizing the safety of their group.

Name: Lillipup
Ecology: Lillipup are found in urban and rural environments, often living near people due to their friendly nature. They live in packs or with human families. Lillipup are omnivorous, eating pet food and foraged goods, displaying a curious and playful personality, enjoying exploring their surroundings.

Name: Herdier
Ecology: Herdier live in close proximity to humans and are commonly found in towns, farms and city environments, where they perform tasks like herding. They live in packs and stay loyal to trainers that bond with them. They eat animal feed as well as meat, having a protective and responsible nature, always working to maintain the safety of the herd.

Name: Stoutland
Ecology: Stoutland often reside in towns and cities, offering aid to people who have lost their way or are in need of help in the mountains, due to their expertise. They live alone in packs but love affection from a trainer. They primarily consume meat and fish but also like a bit of animal feed as well, with a wise and gentle nature, they are looked up to for their helpful abilities.

Name: Purrloin
Ecology: Purrloin are often found in urban areas, sneaking into buildings and stealing items. They tend to live in small, loosely affiliated groups. Purrloin have a diet that consists of discarded food and stolen goods. Purrloin tend to be mischievous and enjoy playing pranks.

Name: Liepard
Ecology: Liepard live in forests and ruins. They are solitary creatures, that only get together with each other to protect their claimed territory from being stolen by other Liepard. Liepard feast on smaller Pokémon which they trick into approaching before using their superior speed. Liepard tend to be quite sadistic, taking joy in harming others.

Name: Pansage
Ecology: Pansage lives in forests, typically near bodies of water. It is herbivorous, consuming leaves and berries. Pansage lives in small groups and is known for its calm and friendly demeanor.

Name: Simisage
Ecology: Simisage lives in lush forests. It is herbivorous, consuming fruits, berries, and leaves. Simisage are solitary or live in small groups, known for their agility and tendency to gather in tree tops.

Name: Pansear
Ecology: Pansear lives in volcanic regions. It eats charcoal to keep its internal fire burning, with a diet supplemented by nuts and berries. Pansear is a social Pokemon and often seen in groups.

Name: Simisear
Ecology: Simisear live in volcanic regions.  Its diet consists of charcoal, with a diet supplemented by nuts and berries. They can live in small family groups, often aggressive and quick to anger when disturbed.

Name: Panpour
Ecology: Panpour live near freshwater sources.  Its diet consists of fresh berries. It is a social creature, living in small groups.

Name: Simipour
Ecology: Simipour live near freshwater sources, particularly rivers and lakes. It typically consumes a variety of aquatic plants and fruits found near the water. Simipour can be solitary or live in small family groups and is known for using its spout to provide water to plants.

Name: Munna
Ecology: Munna inhabits caves and dreams, consuming the dreams of people and Pokemon. They live solitary lives, drifting where their dreams take them. Muna has a curious nature and gentle spirit.

Name: Musharna
Ecology: Musharna dwells in dream worlds. They sustain themselves by eating the dreams of people and Pokémon, and live a solitary life. They live alone, constantly dreaming.

Name: Pidove
Ecology: Pidove are found in urban areas, parks, and forests. They forage seeds, berries, and scraps of food. Pidove typically live in flocks and communicate using gentle cooing sounds. They are known for their friendly and peaceful nature.

Name: Tranquill
Ecology: Tranquill inhabit forests and urban areas, particularly parks and gardens. They are omnivorous, consuming seeds, berries, insects, and scraps of food. Tranquill lives in small groups.

Name: Unfezant
Ecology: Unfezant inhabit plains and forests, where they claim territories to call their own. Its diet is primarily omnivorous; eating seeds, berries, and insects. Males form groups to assert dominance, only the most capable gaining the respect of their peers.

Name: Blitzle
Ecology: Blitzle roam plains and meadows.  It gains energy from thunder, storing it in its mane. Blitzle is herbivorous.

Name: Zebstrika
Ecology: Zebstrika roam open plains. It gains energy from absorbing electricity. Zebstrika eat plants, roots and sometimes tree bark. They are often solitary, marking territories to warn others of their space.

Name: Roggenrola
Ecology: Roggenrola lives in caves and rocky areas. It typically feeds on mineral deposits, and lives in small clusters.

Name: Boldore
Ecology: Boldore live in caves and rocky terrain. It feeds on mineral deposits.  It can live on its own, or may form clusters.

Name: Gigalith
Ecology: Gigalith are found in mountainous regions and caves. They are solitary Pokémon, rarely seen in groups. They feed on minerals they extract from rocks. Gigalith have a rough personality and are not easily approachable.

Name: Woobat
Ecology: Woobat are cave-dwelling Pokémon. They live in dark, damp places and feed on the moisture found in the air. They are social Pokémon, living in colonies. Woobat are known for their calm and gentle personalities.

Name: Swoobat
Ecology: Swoobat inhabits caves and dark forests. These social creatures live in groups and communicate through ultrasonic waves. Their diet consists of fruits and berries. They are known for their romantic and affectionate personalities.

Name: Drilbur
Ecology: Drilbur live underground in tunnels. They use their claws to dig through the earth, feeding on plant roots and small insects. Drilbur are solitary Pokémon and have a determined personality.

Name: Excadrill
Ecology: Excadrill live in underground tunnels, creating complex networks for shelter. Their diet consists of minerals, plant roots, and small insects. These Pokémon are solitary and known for their diligent and industrious nature.

Name: Audino
Ecology: Audino are commonly found in grassy fields and forests. They have excellent hearing abilities and are known for their caring nature. Audino form small family groups. They typically eat medicinal herbs and berries.

Name: Timburr
Ecology: Timburr lives near construction sites and forests, often helping with heavy labor. They train by carrying logs to build their strength. These Pokémon are solitary and are known for their hardworking and simple personalities.

Name: Gurdurr
Ecology: Gurdurr reside in construction sites and forests. They carry iron girders, which they use for training and combat. They often work alongside humans. Gurdurr are known for their industrious and reliable nature.

Name: Conkeldurr
Ecology: Conkeldurr often live near construction sites, having worked alongside humans for many years. They teach younger Timburr and Gurdurr the skills they need. These Pokémon are solitary and are respected for their wisdom.

Name: Tympole
Ecology: Tympole are found in freshwater ponds and marshes. They live in small groups and communicate through unique vibrations. Their diet consists of aquatic plants and small insects. They are timid but curious Pokémon.

Name: Palpitoad
Ecology: Palpitoad are found in swamps and near bodies of water. They use the bumps on their body to create vibrations that can paralyze their prey. They eat small aquatic insects. They are solitary hunters and have an opportunistic nature.

Name: Seismitoad
Ecology: Seismitoad inhabits marshes and wetlands. They use vibrations to weaken opponents, which are transmitted through bumps on their body. They eat large quantities of swamp vegetation and small creatures. They are territorial and live alone.

Name: Throh
Ecology: Throh reside in mountainous regions and forests, living alone in specific training areas. They train rigorously in martial arts. Their diet is composed of roots, berries, and nuts. These Pokémon are known for their stoic personalities.

Name: Sawk
Ecology: Sawk lives in mountainous regions, seeking isolation for training. They hone their karate skills with intense practice. These solitary Pokémon have a strict diet of grains, nuts, and berries. They are known for their disciplined nature.

Name: Sewaddle
Ecology: Sewaddle live in forests. They create coverings for themselves by sewing leaves together with sticky thread. They feed on fallen leaves and live in small groups. They are known for their timid, gentle nature.

Name: Swadloon
Ecology: Swadloon are solitary Pokémon found in forests. They primarily consume decaying leaves, using their leafy exterior for camouflage. Their personality is often described as quiet and reclusive.

Name: Leavanny
Ecology: Leavanny typically inhabit forests, where they nurture smaller Pokémon. They are known to create clothing out of leaves for other Pokémon, showcasing a caring and protective nature. Leavanny are often found in groups, displaying social behavior.

Name: Venipede
Ecology: Venipede are often found in forests and grasslands. They are carnivorous, feeding on smaller insects and plants using venom secreted from their head. Solitary Pokémon that prefer to avoid conflict and have a somewhat timid personality.

Name: Whirlipede
Ecology: Whirlipede can be found in dark caves or dense forests, preying on other creatures. They are usually solitary creatures. They are considered quite aggressive when approached or feel threatened.

Name: Scolipede
Ecology: Scolipede inhabit dense forests and caves. They are known predators, using their speed and agility to catch prey. They are carnivorous creatures, consuming insects and small mammals. They are solitary and aggressive creatures with territorial behavior.

Name: Cottonee
Ecology: Cottonee are found in meadows and fields, where they drift with the wind. They are herbivores that feed on plant pollen. Their light, airy appearance and playful nature make them popular among trainers.

Name: Whimsicott
Ecology: Whimsicott inhabit grassy areas and meadows. They are known for playing pranks, often causing mischief and fun, as well as living in packs. Whimsicott generally feed on sunlight but consume some plants as well.

Name: Petilil
Ecology: Petilil reside in lush grasslands and forests, often near ponds or bodies of water. They are typically solitary Pokémon who are constantly fighting for the sun to blossom their leaves.

Name: Lilligant
Ecology: Lilligant typically inhabit gardens and lush plains. Their diet primarily consists of sunlight and nectar. Lilligant is generally solitary but forms relationships in a group of sorts when around people or other Pokemon.

Name: Basculin-red-striped
Ecology: Basculin reside in bodies of fresh water, usually streams. Basculin is an carnivorous pokemon, primarily eating other fish, as well as living and working in large schools.

Name: Sandile
Ecology: Sandile live in arid desert regions. They are carnivorous and commonly feed on cacti that reside in the deserts, as well as working and travelling together to survive.

Name: Krokorok
Ecology: Krokorok reside in hot, sandy deserts. They feed on creatures that reside within these sandy desert areas. Often are solitary but find refuge within one another when necessary.

Name: Krookodile
Ecology: Krookodile live in the deep, hot parts of desert areas. They consume the desert lizards, and have adapted to be more in tune with hunting behaviors than previous evolutions. They do not work as teams in general, often opting for a solitary approach to surviving.

Name: Darumaka
Ecology: Darumaka live on peaks, and live with one another during their lifecycle. They can also be found eating local plants and leaves on the mountain peaks, however can also hunt for rodents if they choose.

Name: Darmanitan-standard
Ecology: Darmanitan-standard live on peaks with Darumaka. These creatures consume many plants, rodents, and other creatures to stay in their unique Zen Form. Darmanitan generally opt to working in pairs, supporting one another to thrive in nature.

Name: Maractus
Ecology: Maractus primarily inhabits desert regions where it can absorb ample sunlight. Its diet mainly consists of sunlight through photosynthesis, but it also consumes the occasional small desert plant for nutrients. Maractus tend to live solitary lives, as they require ample space for photosynthesis and do not typically form social bonds. They are generally docile and calm, swaying rhythmically to attract prey and absorb sunlight.

Name: Dwebble
Ecology: Dwebble lives in rocky terrains, commonly found in caves, canyons, and mountains. They carve out their own rock shells to live in and protect themselves. Dwebble consumes minerals and small rocks to fortify its shell and supplement its diet with plant roots found in their habitat. These Pokémon live solitarily, protecting their chosen rock, and can exhibit territorial behavior towards other Dwebble. Dwebble are resourceful and determined, always searching for the perfect rock shelter.

Name: Crustle
Ecology: Crustle inhabits rocky terrains, often found near mountains and caves where it sources large rocks for its shell. It consumes minerals and nutrients from rocks, reinforcing its protective home. Crustle is typically solitary but can occasionally be found in small groups, often competing for territory or resources. Crustle is known to be territorial and fiercely protective of its shell, making it appear stubborn and aggressive.

Name: Scraggy
Ecology: Scraggy lives in urban and wilderness areas, often found in groups of other Scraggy. It feeds on berries and tough vegetation found in these areas. Scraggy live in small, competitive groups where they assert dominance and fight for status. Scraggy is characterized by its tough attitude, strong sense of self-preservation, and propensity for trouble.

Name: Scrafty
Ecology: Scrafty are commonly found in urban areas, abandoned buildings, and occasionally rocky terrain. Their diet consists of berries, vegetation, and occasionally small Pokémon, reflecting their adaptability. Scrafty are known to live in gangs, with complex hierarchical structures, where they protect their territory and resources. Scrafty exhibit a tough, rebellious demeanor, are often seen as the leaders of their groups, and display a strong sense of loyalty to their gang.

Name: Sigilyph
Ecology: Sigilyph dwells in ancient ruins, typically in desert environments, often solitary and enigmatic. Its diet is unknown, but it is speculated to absorb solar energy and psychic energy from the surrounding ruins. Sigilyph are typically solitary and highly territorial, patrolling and guarding ancient grounds. They are very mysterious and aloof.

Name: Yamask
Ecology: Yamask wanders the ruins of ancient civilizations, holding a mask that is said to be a replica of its face from when it was human. Yamask feeds on the grief and despair of those around it. These Pokémon are usually solitary, often appearing in desolate places where they seek out lost souls and are known to be sorrowful, often found wandering aimlessly through their haunted habitats.

Name: Cofagrigus
Ecology: Cofagrigus haunts tombs and ruins, often found guarding the burial chambers of ancient kings. It feeds on the life force of those who dare to enter its domain. Cofagrigus are solitary creatures, fiercely protective of their treasure and domain and they possess a sinister and regal air.

Name: Tirtouga
Ecology: Tirtouga live in underwater caves and rocky shorelines, preferring areas with strong currents and plentiful algae. It is an omnivore, feeding on algae, small crustaceans, and plant roots found along the seabed. Tirtouga tend to live solitary lives but occasionally gather in small groups. They are characterized by their gentle nature, resilience, and adaptability.

Name: Carracosta
Ecology: Carracosta frequents coastal waters, rocky shores, and underwater caverns, preferring areas rich in marine life and algae. It is an omnivore, consuming algae, shellfish, and smaller aquatic Pokémon. Carracosta are solitary, fiercely guarding their territories and preying grounds, and display a rugged and protective nature.

Name: Archen
Ecology: Archen inhabits rocky cliffs and mountainous regions, often nesting in high places to avoid predators. It feeds on berries, seeds, and insects found within its habitat. Archen are mostly solitary, forming pairs only during the breeding season. Archen exhibits a curious, active, and explorative nature.

Name: Archeops
Ecology: Archeops reside in rocky terrains, high mountains, and canyons where they build nests on cliff faces. It preys on smaller flying Pokémon, small rodents, and insects, utilizing its speed and agility to hunt effectively. Archeops live solitarily, except during mating season, where they perform aerial displays to attract partners. Archeops is characterized by its speed, aerial prowess, and occasional cautious nature.

Name: Trubbish
Ecology: Trubbish is found in areas with heavy human activity such as landfills, urban streets, and industrial areas. It sustains itself by consuming garbage and waste products. They are often solitary creatures. They adapt to pollution-heavy environments. They possess a toxic nature and unkempt appearance.

Name: Garbodor
Ecology: Garbodor lives in polluted areas like landfills, junkyards, and industrial wastelands. Garbodor thrives on consuming various types of waste and garbage. They can be found solitary or in small groups competing for territory and resources. Garbodor exudes a menacing and aggressive nature due to its dangerous composition and polluted environment.

Name: Zorua
Ecology: Zorua lives in secluded and forested areas, far from human settlements. It sustains itself by eating berries, fruits, and small insects. Zorua are usually solitary, utilizing illusions to protect themselves and find food. Zorua possesses a playful and mischievous nature.

Name: Zoroark
Ecology: Zoroark are solitary creatures that live in forests and bamboo groves. They are nocturnal Pokémon and are known for their cunning and mischievous behavior. Zoroark have the ability to create illusions that they use to protect themselves and trick others. Their diet mainly consists of berries and small Pokémon.

Name: Minccino
Ecology: Minccino are social creatures that live in forests and caves. They are diurnal Pokémon and are known for their cleanliness and love of beauty. Minccino often live in small groups. They primarily consume berries and seeds, showcasing a herbivorous diet.

Name: Cinccino
Ecology: Cinccino are social creatures, often found in groups. They spend a lot of time grooming and preening their fur to keep it clean and shiny. Cinccino are primarily herbivorous, consuming berries and seeds. Their habitat consists of lush forests.

Name: Gothita
Ecology: Gothita are often found alone, lost in their own thoughts. They live in dark forests and urban environments, enjoying solitude and introspection. They are crepuscular. Their diet is unknown, and it is rumored they feed on psychic energy, showcasing a unique diet. They exhibit a solitary nature and are rarely found in groups.

Name: Gothorita
Ecology: Gothorita are commonly found living in urban environments where they have a reliable source of staring power and distraction. While they aren't as openly social as other Pokemon they sometimes are seen in small groups and often cohabitate with Gothita to provide more energy to each other. Gothorita also prefer berries and plants as part of their diet and showcase a semi-social community dynamic.

Name: Gothitelle
Ecology: Gothitelle are very rare creatures that often will disappear to higher mountaintops where there is no human or Pokemon interactions and that leaves them in solitude to see the powers from the heavens. Although they seem to hate interactions, they aren't aggressive and usually move away quickly. Gothitelle diet consists of very low consumption as they don't feed often, mostly from water from the heavens. They live a solitary lifestyle in very high elevations where nobody lives.

Name: Solosis
Ecology: Solosis are solitary creatures that float aimlessly in the air, often found in caves and forests. They communicate through telepathy and feed on electricity. Their habitat ranges from caves to fields, demonstrating adaptability to multiple terrains.

Name: Duosion
Ecology: Duosion are solitary creatures often found in caves and dark forests. They float through the air, using their psychic abilities to move and interact with their environment. Their diet is unknown, but it is believed they feed on psychic energy and absorb nutrients from the air. This makes Duosion solitary and mystical Pokémon.

Name: Reuniclus
Ecology: Reuniclus are solitary creatures that live in caves and forests. They are known for their high intelligence and psychic powers. They can be found floating in the air using the strength of their powers. They are generally friendly Pokémon and not known to be aggressive to others. They are believed to feed on energy and can obtain this from the sun or water through osmosis.

Name: Ducklett
Ecology: Ducklett are often found in ponds and lakes. These waterfowl are commonly found traveling in flocks and are capable divers. They have a strong preference for aquatic plants and invertebrates. This is supported by the fact that their main source of feeding is done at night, meaning that their ecological niche as birds who eat aquatic plants and other organic components makes it easy to flourish.

Name: Swanna
Ecology: Swanna often inhabit large bodies of water such as lakes, ponds and shorelines in large group. These migratory Pokémon tend to fly throughout different countries at a time in sync, indicating that this flying type has an incredible sense of community.

Name: Vanillite
Ecology: Vanillite are typically found in frigid environments like icy caves and snowy mountains. These ice cream-like Pokémon use their frosty exteriors as protection. Vanillite are solitary eaters and tend to stick around ice, thus it is believed that they eat small bugs and insects to adapt to these environments. Thus it is clear that the Vanillite live around harsh ecosystems alone while eating any bugs in their paths.

Name: Vanillish
Ecology: Vanillish live primarily in cold climates and spend most of their time near ice. Because they stay around ice so often, the source of food remains relatively hidden although many believe that the Vanillish do get nutrition from plant matter or even from snow. Vanillish are often seen together in pairs and it is unknown how often this is practiced.

Name: Vanilluxe
Ecology: Vanilluxe lives in frozen environments in order to survive. As large blocks of ice, Vanilluxe need the cold to maintain integrity. Although this Pokemon likes to spend its time in the snowy mountains, not much is known regarding their diet, although most speculate that it likes ice and relies on snow and smaller bugs as a potential option for food.

Name: Deerling
Ecology: Deerling adapt their colors and scent with the seasons, Deerling inhabit areas close to green, lush forests. As herbivores, these small quadrupeds often eat grass and various kinds of berries and are considered social creatures. During migrations, it isn't uncommon for Deerling to stay together and live among different habitats. Because Deerling get along so well, these Pokemon often live near humans to find refuge as long as food sources can be obtained from these different areas.

Name: Sawsbuck
Ecology: Sawsbuck are forest-dwelling Pokémon that change their antlers depending on the season. They graze on leaves and berries, and their social behavior involves forming herds led by the Sawsbuck with the most impressive antlers for the current season. They are generally calm and peaceful, but can be protective of their herd.

Name: Emolga
Ecology: Emolga are commonly found in forests and urban areas. They are social Pokémon, often seen gliding between trees or buildings in small groups. They primarily feed on berries and nuts. Known for their playful and mischievous behavior, they use their electric sacs to startle others and their ability to glide is used for escaping predators.

Name: Karrablast
Ecology: Karrablast live in forests and grasslands. These Pokémon exhibit a unique symbiotic relationship with Shelmet. When a Karrablast evolves by trading with a Shelmet, it steals Shelmet's shell, evolving into Escavalier, while Shelmet evolves into Accelgor. Karrablast are solitary and feed on plant sap.

Name: Escavalier
Ecology: Escavalier inhabit forests. The are solitary Pokemon, and they obtain shells from Shelmet and uses it as armor, becoming a strong cavalry. Feeds primarily on plants. They are courageous Pokémon that charge into battle with their lances.

Name: Foongus
Ecology: Foongus are found in forests, often camouflaged as Poké Balls to lure unsuspecting trainers and Pokémon. These Pokémon feed on decaying organic matter and have a solitary behavior. They have a docile nature.

Name: Amoonguss
Ecology: Amoonguss are found in forests, usually near damp or shaded areas. These Pokémon lure prey with their Poké Ball-like caps and release a poisonous cloud when approached. Amoonguss are solitary Pokémon but can be found in small groups. They consume forest nutrients.

Name: Frillish
Ecology: Frillish are marine Pokémon that inhabit the depths of the ocean. They paralyze prey with their tentacles and feast on life energy. They are usually solitary hunters. It can be predatory and have a playful nature.

Name: Jellicent
Ecology: Jellicent lives in the deepest depths of the ocean and are predatory hunters, often preying on ships and other water Pokémon, draining their life energy. They live in colonies with dominant figures. Some show playful and elegant behavior, and are very intelligent

Name: Alomomola
Ecology: Alomomola inhabit warm ocean waters. They are altruistic, providing healing to injured Pokémon. These Pokémon carry injured Pokémon to shore, providing first aid. Generally travels alone or in pairs.

Name: Joltik
Ecology: Joltik are found in caves, power plants, and forests, where they attach themselves to larger Pokémon and electronic devices to feed on static electricity. These Pokémon often live in small groups. These are scavengers, feeding off of static electricity.

Name: Galvantula
Ecology: Galvantula live in forests and caves, where they create elaborate webs to trap prey. These Pokémon are social and live in colonies. They are nocturnal, hunting small insect Pokémon and feeding off their life energy.

Name: Ferroseed
Ecology: Ferroseed inhabit caves. They are solitary. They attach themselves to cave walls and absorb minerals with their vine-like appendages. Can be very shy and only drop from caves when their nutrition needs can be satisfied.

Name: Ferrothorn
Ecology: Ferrothorn live in caves and forests, where they hang from the ceilings and ambush prey with their spiked vines. These Pokémon are territorial and aggressive. Often solitary to conserve its nutrient supply. Hunts in the darkness.

Name: Klink
Ecology: Klink lives in caves. Klink is two gears that mesh perfectly. Together they live as one. If they do not perfectly mesh they cannot operate correctly. Often found in abandoned structures as well, feed off of metal.

Name: Klang
Ecology: Klang lives in caves and old factories. When Klang meets other Klang, they rotate around each other to search for a perfect fit with which they can fit together. It communicates with clicking sounds.

Name: Klinklang
Ecology: Klinklang typically inhabit industrial areas and power plants, relying on electricity to sustain their metallic bodies. These Pokémon are known to cluster together and communicate through rhythmic clicking sounds. They are solitary and feed on the energy they gather from electrical sources.

Name: Tynamo
Ecology: Tynamo dwell in dark caves and underwater environments. These solitary Pokémon feed on small amounts of electricity, often found near electrical outlets or sources of natural static. Their bodies are fragile, making them cautious and timid in nature.

Name: Eelektrik
Ecology: Eelektrik lives in caves and murky waters where they feed on electricity by attaching themselves to larger aquatic creatures. They tend to be solitary feeders, storing energy within their bodies for survival. Eelektrik are known to be aggressive when disturbed.

Name: Eelektross
Ecology: Eelektross reside in the deepest parts of the ocean, preying on larger aquatic organisms by stunning them with powerful electric shocks. They are solitary hunters and fiercely territorial. Eelektross are adapted to withstand extreme underwater pressure.

Name: Elgyem
Ecology: Elgyem are often found near areas associated with UFO sightings and electromagnetic disturbances. They are solitary and reclusive, often observing humans and Pokémon from a distance. Elgyem use their psychic abilities to manipulate objects and communicate telepathically.

Name: Beheeyem
Ecology: Beheeyem inhabit remote areas, often associated with strange phenomena and unexplained events. These Pokémon live in small groups and are highly intelligent, using their advanced psychic abilities to manipulate their environment. They are mysterious and elusive, rarely seen by humans.

Name: Litwick
Ecology: Litwick dwell in abandoned buildings and dimly lit areas, guiding lost souls with the flame on their head. They are solitary and have a peculiar behavior of absorbing life energy from unsuspecting individuals. Litwick are drawn to places filled with sadness and loneliness.

Name: Lampent
Ecology: Lampent haunt graveyards and abandoned houses, searching for spirits to absorb. They form small groups, often lingering near the recently departed, and use their flames to guide souls to the afterlife. Lampent are drawn to the energy of fear and despair.

Name: Chandelure
Ecology: Chandelure are found in mansions and other elegant buildings, where they absorb life energy from their surroundings, leaving a chilling atmosphere. They are solitary predators that disguise themselves as ornate chandeliers, luring unsuspecting prey. Chandelure thrive on consuming the energy of the living, turning it into fuel for their ghostly flames.

Name: Axew
Ecology: Axew live in forests and caves, where they mark their territory by leaving scratches on trees with their tusks. They are social and form small family groups, often assisting each other in gathering food and defending against predators. Axew primarily feed on berries and tree nuts.

Name: Fraxure
Ecology: Fraxure inhabit mountainous regions and caves, using their sharp tusks to crush rocks in search of minerals. They live in small family groups and fiercely defend their territory. Fraxure primarily consume iron-rich rocks to maintain the strength and sharpness of their tusks.

Name: Haxorus
Ecology: Haxorus live in diverse habitats ranging from forests to caves, using their enormous tusks to cut down trees and challenge rivals. They are solitary and territorial, fiercely guarding their hunting grounds. Haxorus primarily feed on vegetation and smaller Pokémon.

Name: Cubchoo
Ecology: Cubchoo dwell in icy caves and snowy environments, relying on the mucus in their constantly running nose to gauge the surrounding temperature. They are solitary Pokémon, often seen shivering and sniffing. Cubchoo consume snow and ice to regulate their body temperature.

Name: Beartic
Ecology: Beartic live in frozen wastelands and glacial environments, surviving harsh conditions with their thick fur and powerful claws. They are solitary hunters, preying on aquatic Pokémon and terrestrial mammals. Beartic feed on fish and ice to maintain their strength and endurance in the frigid climate.

Name: Cryogonal
Ecology: Cryogonal float in icy caverns and frozen lakes, crystallizing water vapor into intricate patterns. They are solitary creatures, often drifting aimlessly in search of moisture. Cryogonal absorb heat from their surroundings, leaving a trail of intense cold wherever they go.

Name: Shelmet
Ecology: Shelmet live in damp environments, often found in forests near ponds or marshes. They feed on decaying leaves and small insects they find within the vegetation. Shelmet are solitary creatures, spending most of their time buried in the soil to keep their bodies moist, only emerging to feed or find a mate. They are known to be timid and prefer to avoid confrontation by retreating into their shells.

Name: Accelgor
Ecology: Accelgor are found in grassy areas and forests. They are extremely fast and agile, capable of traversing through dense foliage with ease. These Pokémon feed on the energy they absorb from the sun. Accelgor are solitary hunters, darting around at high speeds to catch smaller insect Pokémon. Their personality is often described as hyperactive and impulsive.

Name: Stunfisk
Ecology: Stunfisk dwells in muddy wetlands, beaches, and riverbeds, using its flat body to camouflage itself in the sediment. It's an ambush predator, lying in wait to shock unsuspecting prey that come into contact with it. Their diet consists of small fish and aquatic invertebrates. Stunfisk tend to be solitary Pokémon with a patient, albeit sometimes grumpy, disposition.

Name: Mienfoo
Ecology: Mienfoo inhabit mountainous and rocky regions, honing their martial arts skills through rigorous training. They consume berries and small plants, but also hunt small rodent Pokemon using their impressive fighting abilities. Mienfoo are known to live in small groups, where they learn from and compete with each other to improve their combat prowess. They are often described as disciplined and dedicated, always striving to become stronger.

Name: Mienshao
Ecology: Mienshao resides in the mountains and forests, where they use their whip-like arms to strike at prey and swing between trees. They feed on berries and fruit, supplementing their diet with small mammals and bird Pokemon that they can catch with their swift movements. Mienshao live in small family groups led by the most skilled fighter. They are generally calm but will fiercely protect their territory and young.

Name: Druddigon
Ecology: Druddigon make their homes in caves, where they use their rough skin to blend in with the rocky walls. They primarily feed on smaller Pokémon found within the caves and occasionally venture out to hunt at night. Druddigon are solitary creatures, staking out territory to ward off others. They have a reputation for being territorial and aggressive but are generally not a threat unless provoked.

Name: Golett
Ecology: Golett are often found in ruins and ancient sites, hinting at their creation by an ancient civilization. Their diet is unusual; they consume soil and rocks to sustain themselves. Golett are solitary Pokemon. They are quiet and docile, carrying out simple tasks until given a more specific command.

Name: Golurk
Ecology: Golurk guard ancient ruins and are said to have been activated to protect people and Pokémon from danger. Their diet consists of consuming energy they absorb from the sun or by igniting and burning fuel within their body. Golurk is a solitary protector. It is fiercely loyal and possesses great strength to fulfill its duty.

Name: Pawniard
Ecology: Pawniard can be found in mountainous regions or near human settlements. They often work together in groups, led by a Bisharp, to hunt prey or raid for resources. They are carnivorous, feeding on other smaller Pokémon that they take down through coordinated attacks. Pawniard are known to be obedient to their leader but are also ambitious, constantly striving to prove their strength and rise in rank within their group.

Name: Bisharp
Ecology: Bisharp lead groups of Pawniard in territorial battles, ruling with an iron fist. They typically inhabit mountainous or urban areas, often staking claim over territory. Bisharp compete with others for dominance and feed on weaker Pokemon defeated in combat, showcasing their cruel nature. They are solitary unless leading a group of Pawniard.

Name: Bouffalant
Ecology: Bouffalant primarily roam in grasslands, plains, and meadows. It is a herbivore, consuming grass and foliage. They live in herds and are fiercely protective of their territory and herd-mates. Bouffalant is known for its aggression when provoked, charging at foes with immense force.

Name: Rufflet
Ecology: Rufflet is found in mountainous regions. Rufflet often form flocks as they train for evolution, but they can often be found solitary in low elevations, nesting amongst low-lying flora. These Pokemon are carnivores; as such, their diet consists of meat. A rufflet can generally be found to have an ambitious, rough personality and they strive to evolve into a powerful Braviary.

Name: Braviary
Ecology: Braviary resides within harsh and untamed mountainous terrain. As they are at the top of the food chain in the respective environments, these Pokemon often are solo, and they primarily feed on other flying Pokemon. Their diet also consists of other land dwelling creatures; Braviary has often been cited taking down entire herds of deerling. They are well-renowned for being brave, and known to be at peace even in tough situations.

Name: Vullaby
Ecology: Vullaby nests in mountainous areas and scavenges for discarded bones to use as diaper. Their diet mainly consists of small pokemon and dead caracasses, consuming everything within a short period of time. A Vullaby will often nest by itself with their respective parent; they are calm but alert to potential predators and can often be found staring blankly towards nothing for long periods of time.

Name: Mandibuzz
Ecology: Mandibuzz lives in dry, rocky habitats, nesting within desolate areas due to their morbid lifestyle. The ecology for the species has drastically changed with increased settlements; a Mandibuzz will search high and low amongst human settlements for scrap items and food to consume and decorate their nests. When travelling by itself, the bone-bird tends to have a laid-back and almost nonchalant demeanor.

Name: Heatmor
Ecology: Heatmor typically inhabits volcanic regions and hot caves, preying on Durant with its heated tongue. They are solitary creatures, fiercely territorial, and possess a volatile personality.

Name: Durant
Ecology: Durant live in colonies, building intricate tunnel systems within caves and forests. They consume leaves and other organic matter, communicating through pheromones. Durant are industrious, disciplined, and maintain a cooperative social structure.

Name: Deino
Ecology: Deino are commonly found in dark caves and dense forests, relying on their keen sense of smell to navigate. They are fiercely aggressive, often biting anything that moves due to their inability to see. Deino are solitary creatures with a rambunctious and destructive personality.

Name: Zweilous
Ecology: Zweilous are commonly found in dark caves and dense forests, often competing with its other head for dominance. They are fiercely aggressive and known for their destructive behavior. Zweilous are solitary creatures with a hostile personality.

Name: Hydreigon
Ecology: Hydreigon are commonly found in mountainous terrains and caverns, they are known for their destructive and violent behavior. Hydreigon are solitary creatures with a brutal personality.

Name: Larvesta
Ecology: Larvesta typically dwells in forests and grasslands near volcanic activity, feeding on tree sap and nectar. They are solitary Pokémon known for their gentle demeanor and tendency to approach warm objects. Larvesta are often found near light sources and exhibit a curious personality.

Name: Volcarona
Ecology: Volcarona reside in mountainous regions with warm climates and are associated with legends of being incarnations of the sun. They feed on sunlight and nectar, displaying a benevolent presence that provides warmth to the environment. Volcarona are revered as guardians of life and possess a serene personality.

Name: Cobalion
Ecology: Cobalion typically dwells in mountainous regions with dense forests, acting as a leader of a trio of legendary Pokémon. They consume berries and plant-based foods, maintaining a solitary lifestyle while monitoring human activity. Cobalion are known for their unwavering justice and possess a stoic personality.

Name: Terrakion
Ecology: Terrakion inhabits rocky terrains and caves, acting as part of a trio of legendary Pokémon alongside Cobalion and Virizion. They feed on minerals and rocks, maintaining a solitary lifestyle while acting as a protector of Pokémon habitats. Terrakion are renowned for their indomitable strength and possess a resolute personality.

Name: Virizion
Ecology: Virizion dwells in lush forests and grasslands, acting as part of a trio of legendary Pokémon alongside Cobalion and Terrakion. They consume fruits and flowers, maintaining a solitary lifestyle while protecting Pokémon from human threats. Virizion are known for their graceful movements and possess a compassionate personality.

Name: Tornadus-incarnate
Ecology: Tornadus-incarnate is found roaming in the skies, typically in regions with unstable weather patterns. They primarily feed on atmospheric energy and moisture. They have a solitary nature with a volatile and mischievous personality, often creating destructive storms for amusement.

Name: Thundurus-incarnate
Ecology: Thundurus-incarnate is commonly found in areas with thunderstorms and charged atmosphere. They absorb electrical energy from the environment, and are typically solitary. Thundurus are known to be destructive with a wild, erratic personality, creating havoc by unleashing powerful lightning strikes.

Name: Reshiram
Ecology: Reshiram inhabits areas with strong ties to mythical legends, often in regions of high altitude or hidden ruins. They feed on positive energy and aspirations, and are considered solitary creatures with a majestic, benevolent presence. Reshiram have a serene and wise personality, symbolizing truth and creation.

Name: Zekrom
Ecology: Zekrom dwell in areas with abundant electrical energy, such as storm clouds or industrial complexes. They absorb electrical energy from the environment, and are solitary creatures with a powerful, enigmatic presence. Zekrom have a stern and determined personality, representing ideals and destruction.

Name: Landorus-incarnate
Ecology: Landorus-incarnate is found in fertile lands, roaming the regions and spreading its blessings. They are responsible for promoting agricultural prosperity, often solitary but will cooperate with other Pokémon or humans who respect nature. Landorus are seen as benevolent figures with a generous personality, symbolizing abundance and gratitude.

Name: Kyurem
Ecology: Kyurem, the Boundary Pokémon, is a legendary creature of the Unova region. It is said to have arrived on a meteor and possesses immense power. Kyurem is typically found in remote, icy caves and frozen wastelands, favoring solitude due to its formidable aura. As an incomplete Pokémon formed from the split of Reshiram and Zekrom, Kyurem seeks to fuse with one of them to restore its original form, becoming either White Kyurem or Black Kyurem. In its solitary existence, Kyurem feeds on whatever it can find within its frozen habitat, demonstrating a personality marked by a deep sense of incompleteness and latent power.

Name: Keldeo-ordinary
Ecology: Keldeo, the Colt Pokémon, is a legendary creature known for its swift movements and graceful appearance. Typically found near bodies of water, such as lakes and rivers, Keldeo often resides in areas rich in plant life where it can graze and quench its thirst. As a member of the Swords of Justice, Keldeo is often seen training with its comrades, honing its skills in both combat and agility. Living in small, tight-knit groups, Keldeo is a social creature, displaying a playful and energetic personality while also remaining dedicated to its mission of protecting Pokémon and humans alike. Their diet primarily consists of aquatic plants and berries found near their watery homes.

Name: Meloetta-aria
Ecology: Meloetta, the Melody Pokémon, is a legendary creature celebrated for its enchanting voice and captivating dances. This Pokémon typically resides in serene and untouched environments, such as ancient forests and hidden glades, where its melodies can resonate in harmony with nature. As a solitary Pokémon, Meloetta spends much of its time honing its vocal and dance abilities, using its songs to bring joy and peace to those who listen. Its diet primarily consists of berries and fruits, enhancing its energy and maintaining the clarity of its voice. Known for its gentle and kind-hearted nature, Meloetta is often sought after for its ability to soothe and inspire.

Name: Genesect
Ecology: Genesect, the Paleozoic Pokémon, is a Bug/Steel type Pokémon that existed 300 million years ago. Modified by Team Plasma with mechanical parts, Genesect became a formidable opponent, but the changes also disrupted its natural ecology. In its natural habitat, Genesect would have likely lived in forests and hunted as a predator. Its diet probably consisted of smaller Bug-type Pokémon and plant matter. Socially, they may have lived in small packs for hunting or defense, and they would have spent time in lush, green forests, possibly during warmer periods in history. With its modifications, Genesect exhibits a tendency to be aggressive and obedient, driven by the influence of those who control its systems.

Name: Chespin
Ecology: Chespin, the Spiny Nut Pokémon, is a Grass-type Pokémon that is native to the Kalos region. These Pokémon are often found in forests and grassy areas where they can easily access their primary food source: nuts. Chespin are herbivores and primarily feed on nuts they find on the forest floor, using their tough shells to protect them from potential threats. Chespin are generally social Pokémon, living in small groups or families, and exhibit playful and curious behaviors.

Name: Quilladin
Ecology: Quilladin, the Spiny Armor Pokémon, is a Grass-type Pokémon that evolves from Chespin. It is native to the Kalos region and is commonly found in forests and grassy areas. Quilladin, as a herbivore, consumes plant materials such as nuts, fruits, and leaves. These Pokémon have social habits; they gather in small groups and families. Their personality is generally calm, but they have increased defensiveness, forming the shell, to fend off potential danger.

Name: Chesnaught
Ecology: Chesnaught, the Spiny Armor Pokémon, is a Grass/Fighting-type Pokémon, and final evolution of Chespin. Its diet primarily includes nuts, berries, and fruits which provides it with ample energy for its robust physique and battles. Often found in dense forests with its family group, Chesnaught, like Chespin, is very social in nature. These Pokemon are also extremely protective, showcasing fierce loyalty to their friends and family.

Name: Fennekin
Ecology: Fennekin, the Fox Pokémon, are typically found in dry, arid environments such as deserts or savannas within the Kalos region. These Fire-type Pokémon primarily feed on small, dry plants, berries, and insects, using their large ears to detect prey and potential dangers. Fennekin tends to live solitary lives, though they may occasionally form small family units, and possess a curious and playful nature.

Name: Braixen
Ecology: Braixen, the Fox Pokémon, inhabits forests and grasslands in the Kalos region. They are often found with a twig in their tail, which they use as a makeshift wand and source of comfort. The Fire-type Pokémon's diet mainly consists of berries and small insects. While Braixen enjoys its own space, they occasionally team up with others to form families and smaller hunting teams. Known to be shy, they bond well within family settings.

Name: Delphox
Ecology: Delphox, the Fox Pokémon, is typically found in mystical and secluded forests within the Kalos region. This Fire/Psychic-type Pokémon often dwells near ancient ruins or areas with strong psychic energy, which it draws upon to enhance its magical abilities. Delphox tends to be solitary, preferring the company of its own thoughts, but it is also known to be a wise and benevolent guide for lost travelers. The Pokemon's diet mainly consists of berries, nuts, and occasionally small animals that inhabit its forest home.

Name: Froakie
Ecology: Froakie, the Bubble Frog Pokémon, is typically found in wetland areas in the Kalos region, near bodies of water like ponds and rivers. This Water-type Pokémon predominantly feeds on insects and small aquatic plants, using the bubbles on its chest and back to navigate and trap its prey. Socially, Froakie are independent creatures, often living solitary lives, but they are also known to be quite playful and energetic, leaping through water and engaging in playful antics.

Name: Frogadier
Ecology: Frogadier, the Bubble Frog Pokémon, typically lives in secluded areas near bodies of water in the Kalos region, such as hidden ponds and forest streams. As a Water-type Pokémon, Frogadier mainly consumes insects and small aquatic organisms, using its agility to hunt and evade predators. They mostly live solitary lifestyles. Frogadier tends to have a reserved personality, focusing on honing its skills and becoming stronger. They value independence and resourcefulness, often using the bubbles on their chest and back as disguises or to create diversions.

Name: Greninja
Ecology: Greninja, the Ninja Pokémon, is often found near hidden freshwater sources in the Kalos region, such as secluded ponds or forested streams. As a Water/Dark-type Pokémon, Greninja primarily consumes insects, fish, and small amphibians. This Pokemon is solitary creatures, preferring to live and hunt alone; they can display a strong sense of loyalty and are protective of those they trust. They tend to be silent and calculating, choosing their battles wisely.

Name: Bunnelby
Ecology: Bunnelby, the Digging Pokémon, prefers to dwell in rural areas such as grasslands and farmlands throughout the Kalos region. A Normal-type Pokémon, they often nest in burrows that they dig themselves. It is primarily herbivorous, feeding on roots, plant shoots, and any crops it can scavenge. Bunnelby lives in colonies with multiple Bunnellby; they work together to look after each other as well as construct burrows that will serve as both safe haven as well as sources for storing food.

Name: Diggersby
Ecology: Diggersby, the Digging Pokémon, is often found in rural areas in the Kalos region such as farms, grasslands and prairies. These Normal/Ground-type Pokemon have gigantic ears capable of digging up thick tree roots; using that capability as a means of locating sources of nourishment, mainly consuming tubers and roots. Like its predecessor Bunnelby, it lives in extensive warrens, and are extremely diligent caretakers. Their tough-love demeanor leads Diggersby to keep its dependents under firm hand and will fight tooth and nail for its loved ones.

Name: Fletchling
Ecology: Fletchling are commonly found in forests and plains, often in small flocks. They feed on berries and small insects, exhibiting a cheerful and social nature.

Name: Fletchinder
Ecology: Fletchinder reside in mountainous regions and forests. They are carnivorous, preying on smaller bird Pokémon and insects. They tend to be solitary hunters, exhibiting a fierce and territorial behavior.

Name: Talonflame
Ecology: Talonflame inhabit volcanic regions and mountainous areas. They are apex predators, hunting larger bird Pokémon and small mammals. They live in small family groups and show great loyalty and bravery.

Name: Scatterbug
Ecology: Scatterbug are found in forests and gardens, usually near plants where they can feed on leaves. They live in small groups and are timid, hiding among foliage.

Name: Spewpa
Ecology: Spewpa dwell in forests and grasslands, enclosed in their protective shells. They feed on plant sap and remain largely motionless, avoiding predators with their camouflage and defensive shell.

Name: Vivillon
Ecology: Vivillon live in various habitats, depending on their wing pattern, ranging from forests to deserts. They feed on flower nectar and are social, gathering in large groups. Their personalities vary depending on the habitat they come from.

Name: Litleo
Ecology: Litleo are found in savannas and rocky terrains, typically in prides led by a Pyroar. They eat berries and small mammals. Litleo are known for their brave and energetic personalities, always eager to prove themselves.

Name: Pyroar
Ecology: Pyroar inhabit savannas and grasslands, leading prides of Litleo. They hunt larger prey, such as Zebstrika and Bouffalant. They exhibit regal and commanding behavior, fiercely protective of their pride.

Name: Flabebe
Ecology: Flabébé are found in flower gardens and meadows, always near their chosen flower, with which they form a symbiotic relationship. They feed on flower nectar. Flabébé are gentle and affectionate, showing great care for their flower.

Name: Floette
Ecology: Floette live in fields of flowers and meadows, often migrating with their chosen flower. They consume nectar and pollen, forming strong bonds with their floral companions. They are elegant and graceful, often seen dancing in the wind.

Name: Florges
Ecology: Florges dwell in elaborate flower gardens, creating and maintaining beautiful displays. They consume nutrients from the soil and air through their flowers. They are benevolent and nurturing, caring deeply for their garden and its inhabitants.

Name: Skiddo
Ecology: Skiddo live on plains and mountainous slopes. They eat grass and leaves and often carry people on their backs. They are known for their gentle, dependable nature and love to be helpful to humans.

Name: Gogoat
Ecology: Gogoat live in mountainous regions, forming herds. They graze on vegetation and are used as a mode of transportation. Gogoat are dependable and serene, forming strong bonds with their riders.

Name: Pancham
Ecology: Pancham reside in bamboo forests and mountainous areas. They feed on bamboo shoots and berries. Pancham are playful and mischievous, often trying to act tough, but they have a soft spot for their friends.

Name: Pangoro
Ecology: Pangoro dwell in bamboo forests, wandering the mountains. They consume bamboo and other plants. Pangoro are aggressive and protective, acting as guardians of the forests and displaying surprising tenderness towards those they protect.

Name: Furfrou
Ecology: Furfrou are known to be particularly popular in high society, and are quite intelligent.  They have a coat of fur that needs constant trimming in order to stay healthy, and have various forms in which the fur on their head and neck are styled into, called trims. They are native to Kalos, often kept by those of high society who groom their coats into different forms.

Name: Espurr
Ecology: Espurr's ecology is characterized by its solitary nature and powerful psychic abilities. Due to its immense psychic power being uncontrollable, it is always under the restraint of its ears. These pokemon often lives alone and can be found hiding in dark corners or abandoned buildings. They possess an intense gaze that can be unsettling to those who meet their eyes. This pokemon's power is so immense that it risks being released unintentionally and as such it always appears to be restraining its anger.

Name: Meowstic-male
Ecology: Meowstic typically lives in pairs, showcasing distinct differences between the male and female. They often inhabit urban and suburban areas.  The males are solitary hunters, emitting waves to cause headaches to any aggressors to protect its territory. They often restrain themselves, disliking others.

Name: Honedge
Ecology: Honedge is reborn from a soul of a person that once used the sword that it inhabits. Honedge can be found within ancient ruins or battlegrounds. It attaches itself to people and drains the energy from anyone who dares to grasp its hilt. These pokemon typically are found alone and haunt forgotten or abandoned places.

Name: Doublade
Ecology: Doublade live among historical sites. It works in tandem with another Doublade, coordinating attacks to overwhelm opponents with dazzling sword work. Carelessly grabbing both swords is quite dangerous, as both Doublade will swing without a trainer present.

Name: Aegislash-shield
Ecology: Aegislash are able to change form in battle due to their Stance Change ability. When Aegislash is ready to attack, its defensive form will switch to an offensive form, and when it anticipates an incoming blow, it changes to its defensive stance. Legends say it once served kings and controlled people and Pokémon to conquer the world. It is very rare to find naturally.

Name: Spritzee
