Ecology: Spritzee are commonly found near floral habitats due to the fragrances they emits and are also found in human settlements, kept for their delightful scent. Its body emits a unique fragrance that varies based on its diet and environmental factors. In ancient times, noble ladies carried a Spritzee instead of perfume.

Name: Aromatisse
Ecology: Aromatisse are typically found near urban centers, flourishing due to the variety of floral and spice-based ingredients needed to make its perfume. It emits a unique fragrance that it can control, creating different scents for different purposes. Aromatisse emits various different scents that cause anyone who smells them to imagine things, whether that be good things or bad.

Name: Swirlix
Ecology: Swirlix lives in meadows and forests in the Kalos region. This Pokemon loves to eat sweets and is usually very docile.  It emits a sweet, cotton candy-like scent that attracts other Pokemon. Its body is composed almost entirely of sugary substances.

Name: Slurpuff
Ecology: Slurpuff's senses of smell are highly attuned to different tastes. This pokemon resides near urban areas where sugary ingredients can be obtained. It can distinguish subtle differences in flavor and fragrance. Slurpuff is commonly employed in the confectionery industry, aiding chefs with their impeccable palettes to bake perfect recipes.

Name: Inkay
Ecology: Inkay are known for their bioluminescent spots and are often found in coastal areas of the Kalos region. It is able to control the minds of its foes by flashing the light-emitting spots on its body. When facing a powerful opponent, Inkay blinds it with a burst of light before fleeing.

Name: Malamar
Ecology: Malamar are able to influence other creatures. Using these psychic powers, it is able to bend others to its own malevolent will. People are compelled to do whatever Malamar wants of them, though they soon forget this as Malamar exits their territory.

Name: Binacle
Ecology: Binacle live in rocky areas and coastal cliffs and are often attached to large rocks or other surfaces. They often live in pairs. Though generally peaceful, the two Binacle will fight if they do not share the same living space.  When faced against predators, the Binacle will attack at the same time to ward off any attacks. One seeks food for the other.

Name: Barbaracle
Ecology: Barbaracle colonies inhabit rocky coastlines near the ocean. Each of Barbaracle's limbs acts and thinks independently and they can act of their own accord in battle, yet they work together with surprising coordination. The legs of Barbaracle are capable of moving separately. These pokemon are extremely brutal and are often viewed as dangerous.

Name: Skrelp
Ecology: Skrelp live in dense kelp forests, camouflaging themselves to ambush unsuspecting prey and are commonly found among seaweed and coral reefs. They filter nutrients from the water, which helps sustain their bodies. Using the water absorbed, it ejects a poisonous liquid. It also uses this spray to paralyze any prey.

Name: Dragalge
Ecology: Dragalge are found in the deep sea, pretending to be seaweed to ambush prey. They are solitary hunters and possess a highly toxic poison that can corrode metal. They are territorial and will fiercely defend their hunting grounds.

Name: Clauncher
Ecology: Clauncher lives near the coast, where it hides among rocks and seaweed. This Pokémon primarily feeds on small aquatic creatures, using its oversized claw to capture and crush its prey. Clauncher are solitary, only grouping during mating season. Its personality is energetic, but can also be easily startled.

Name: Clawitzer
Ecology: Clawitzer habitat is coastal regions with clear water and rocky structures. Solitary hunters, Clawitzer preys on fish, shellfish, and other aquatic animals, using their oversized claw to create sonic blasts. Their common personality traits are bold, territorial, and prefer to remain solitary, except during mating season.

Name: Helioptile
Ecology: Helioptile lives in arid, sunny environments, such as deserts and rocky outcrops. Their diet mainly consists of berries, plant leaves, and small insects. Helioptile often lives in small groups to pool body heat. Helioptile Pokémon are known for being energetic, curious, and often found sunbathing on rocks.

Name: Heliolisk
Ecology: Heliolisk lives in arid regions, usually around bodies of water. It uses the frills on the sides of its head to generate electricity from sunlight, which it can use to power its own moves. It primarily eats berries, small insects and foliage. These pokemon form small groups. The pokemon has a calm, relaxed demeanor and can get very energized with too much sun exposure.

Name: Tyrunt
Ecology: Tyrunt once roamed the ancient world, specifically preferring temperate forests and open plains with access to water sources. Their diet consisted mainly of tough plant matter and smaller prehistoric creatures, using their strong jaws to crush bones. These Pokémon likely lived in small family groups, led by an older, more experienced individual. Personality traits would include assertiveness, territoriality, and a tendency to compete for resources.

Name: Tyrantrum
Ecology: Tyrantrum ruled ancient lands with dominance over its territory. These apex predators roamed forests and plains where it would prey on large and small creatures. These Pokémon were solitary hunters, only gathering to raise young, and displayed aggression, territoriality, and were solitary, only forming loose familial groups.

Name: Amaura
Ecology: Amaura once lived in cold environments, such as tundra and icy plains, but has been revived through fossils in the modern day. It grazes on frozen vegetation, using its ability Refrigerate to freeze the surrounding air and generate a layer of ice. The Pokémon were often found in herds, traveling together to find food and stay warm. Docile, gentle, and are known to be more active during the daytime when the sun is out.

Name: Aurorus
Ecology: Aurorus inhabited icy regions, surviving on frozen foliage in the tundra. Aurorus often travelled in herds for protection and companionship, communicating using cries. Their temperament is calm, graceful, and they were known to be more active during the daytime when the sun is out.

Name: Sylveon
Ecology: Sylveon tends to live in forests and meadows near urban areas, seeking companionship with humans and other Pokémon. Sylveon typically lives in small groups, sometimes forming bonds with humans or other Pokémon species. These Fairy types display friendliness, affection, and they use their ribbon-like feelers to comfort others and display affection.

Name: Hawlucha
Ecology: Hawlucha resides in forests and jungles where it can utilize trees to execute aerial attacks and practice its fighting moves. Hawlucha tend to form small communities, engaging in sparring matches to improve their skills and strength. Boastful, energetic, and are known for their showmanship in battle, as well as its honorable nature and will defend its territory.

Name: Dedenne
Ecology: Dedenne resides in forests and meadows where it can easily access electrical outlets. Their diet includes berries, seeds, and the occasional electrical energy drawn from power outlets. It typically lives in small groups to pool body heat and communicate through electric pulses. Friendly, curious, and emits electrical signals that it uses to communicate with other Dedenne.

Name: Carbink
Ecology: Carbink are born deep underground where they are formed under intense pressure and heat. Carbink primarily consume minerals and nutrients found in the rock formations of their habitat, sometimes gathering gems. The Pokémon often congregate in small clusters, communicating telepathically to share information. Calm, mysterious, and highly valued for its beauty, as well as its ability to purify gems.

Name: Goomy
Ecology: Goomy prefers damp, shady environments. Goomy are often found in swamps, bogs, and areas with high humidity. Goomy eat leaves, decaying plant matter, and berries. Typically a solitary Pokémon.

Name: Sliggoo
Ecology: Sliggoo live in damp caves and forests. To remain hidden they blend in to their damp surroundings using their gooey bodies to blend in. They use the horns on their head to smell out prey, they also feed on plant matter.

Name: Goodra
Ecology: Goodra live in forests and swamps, preferring damp environments. They are solitary Pokémon, rarely seen in groups. Their diet consists of fruits, which they gather by extending their horns like arms. Goodra are known to be very friendly and affectionate, often showering their trainers with slimy hugs.

Name: Klefki
Ecology: Klefki are found in urban areas, especially around buildings with metal doors and gates. They are solitary creatures and are often seen collecting keys, which they dangle from their ring. Klefki are known to be mischievous, using their keys to play pranks on unsuspecting people. They feed on the metal found in keys.

Name: Phantump
Ecology: Phantump inhabit forests, often lingering near graveyards or abandoned buildings. These Pokémon are born when spirits possess tree stumps, giving them a spectral and eerie presence. Phantump are solitary, with mournful calls. It's said they lure people deeper into the forest, though their intentions are not always malicious. Their diet consists of ambient life force and the minerals from decaying wood.

Name: Trevenant
Ecology: Trevenant live deep within forests, serving as guardians of the woods. They are solitary creatures and are rarely seen by humans. Trevenant can control trees, using them to create barriers or to ensnare intruders. They are known to be very protective of the forest, punishing those who harm it. They gain sustenance from the forest, absorbing nutrients and energy from the trees around them.

Name: Pumpkaboo-average
Ecology: Pumpkaboo live in haunted houses and spooky forests, often appearing during Halloween. They are solitary Pokémon, sometimes seen in small groups. Pumpkaboo carry around a light, which they use to lure people to them. It's said they bring lost souls to the afterlife, making them important figures in ghost stories. Their diet includes sweet things.

Name: Gourgeist-average
Ecology: Gourgeist inhabit haunted houses and spooky forests, often appearing during Halloween. Gourgeist are solitary and territorial. Gourgeist sing cheerfully as they walk through towns on Halloween night. Anyone who hears its song is said to be cursed. Its diet consists of spirits.

Name: Bergmite
Ecology: Bergmite live on icy mountains and in cold caves, often forming groups on icebergs. Bergmite are social and are often seen clinging to each other to stay warm. They are known to be very resilient, able to withstand freezing temperatures. Bergmite prey on small ice-dwelling creatures.

Name: Avalugg
Ecology: Avalugg are found in snowy mountains and icy regions, where they create their massive bodies. They are solitary Pokémon. Avalugg are known to be very territorial, attacking anyone who enters their territory. Avalugg feeds on large quantities of ice.

Name: Noibat
Ecology: Noibat dwell in dark caves and forests, using their ultrasonic waves to navigate and hunt. They live in colonies within these caves and have a strong social hierarchy. Noibat have a keen sense of smell and seek out fruits and berries. These Pokemon are typically shy, but are fiercely protective of their colony.

Name: Noivern
Ecology: Noivern live in dark caves and forests. Noivern are often seen in small groups or pairs, patrolling their territory. Noivern are known to be very aggressive, attacking anyone who threatens their territory. Noivern primarily feed on fruits and berries.

Name: Xerneas
Ecology: Xerneas live in lush forests. Xerneas are solitary and only gather when replenishing the forest's life force. These Pokemon are considered benevolent creatures, sharing their life energy to revitalize plants and heal weakened Pokémon. Its diet is ambient energy and it can also eat plants.

Name: Yveltal
Ecology: Yveltal inhabit desolate areas, such as abandoned ruins and desolate landscapes. They are solitary Pokémon. They are aggressive and feared. Yveltal steal the life force of living beings to sustain themselves. They are a danger to the ecosystem around them.

Name: Zygarde-50
Ecology: Zygarde live in caves and ruins and rarely emerge. Zygarde's 50% Forme travels within its designated territory. Zygarde typically act as protectors of the environment and order. Their diet consists of the nutrients within the Earth's crust.

Name: Diancie
Ecology: Diancie are rarely seen in the wild. They live in diamond ore veins deep underground and are solitary. Their diet consists of air, which they convert into diamonds.

Name: Hoopa
Ecology: Hoopa prefers living in confined, isolated areas. Hoopa are known to hoard items. Hoopa are highly mischievous. Hoopa's diet primarily consists of psychic energy. They enjoy playing tricks on unsuspecting individuals, particularly stealing valuable objects and then laughing as they watch people search frantically for their belongings.

Name: Volcanion
Ecology: Volcanion is a solitary Pokémon that dwells in mountainous regions, particularly near hot springs and geothermal vents. It feeds on geothermal energy and minerals found in the earth, converting them into steam. Volcanion has a reserved and stoic personality, often keeping to itself and avoiding contact with humans and other Pokémon unless provoked.

Name: Rowlet
Ecology: Rowlet is a nocturnal Pokémon that roosts in dark, secluded areas such as forests and caves. During the day, it soaks up solar energy through its wings. Its diet consists of berries and small insects. Rowlet is typically solitary and territorial, preferring to be alone but showing aggression to defend its territory.

Name: Dartrix
Ecology: Dartrix resides in dense forests, blending in with the foliage. Dartrix are known to have a keen interest in their appearance, grooming their feathers meticulously and carrying sharp blades hidden within them. Dartrix tend to be solitary creatures with a prideful personality.

Name: Decidueye
Ecology: Decidueye are often found in forests or ruins. They prefer living in solitude but are fiercely protective of their territory. They consume berries and occasionally small bird Pokémon, acting as predators in their ecosystem. Decidueye possesses a mysterious and silent personality, known to strike unseen from the shadows.

Name: Litten
Ecology: Litten typically inhabits urban areas and abandoned buildings. They have a diet consisting primarily of small rodents and birds, which they hunt using stealth and agility. Litten are solitary creatures, preferring to live independently, but they may form bonds with humans or other Pokémon.

Name: Torracat
Ecology: Torracat dwells in grassy plains and rocky terrain. They hunt prey by ambushing them from tall grass and rocky outcrops. Torracat are solitary creatures with a fiery temperament. They fiercely defend their territory from intruders, showcasing an aggressive and independent personality.

Name: Incineroar
Ecology: Incineroar dwells in urban and rural areas, where it can access sources of sustenance, like smaller Pokémon. They are carnivorous, feeding on smaller creatures. Incineroar are known for their aggression and showmanship, reveling in combat and demonstrating a flair for the dramatic.

Name: Popplio
Ecology: Popplio lives primarily in coastal waters and open sea. They consume seaweed and small fish. Popplio tend to be playful and gregarious, enjoying interacting with other members of their colony and humans. They are known to be entertainers, using their aquatic acrobatics to captivate audiences.

Name: Brionne
Ecology: Brionne live in tropical seas and coral reefs. They hunt for fish and other marine life together. Brionne are often friendly and sociable, thriving in communities and working together to catch food.

Name: Primarina
Ecology: Primarina thrives in tropical and subtropical seas. Primarina lives in groups and sings melodies to charm humans. It feeds on aquatic life.

Name: Pikipek
Ecology: Pikipek is found in forests and woodlands. They excavate nesting cavities in trees, and they can drill holes through trees and other hard surfaces. Pikipek usually gathers in small flocks.

Name: Trumbeak
Ecology: Trumbeak lives in rainforests and jungle environments. Trumbeak are typically found in small flocks. It communicates with other Trumbeak using over 50 distinct cries.

Name: Toucannon
Ecology: Toucannon inhabits dense tropical rainforests. It tends to be found in small family groups, which may exhibit a strong sense of community and cooperation when it comes to foraging and protecting themselves.

Name: Yungoos
Ecology: Yungoos lives in meadows. They can often be seen foraging in groups during the daytime. It primarily feeds on bugs and other small insects.

Name: Gumshoos
Ecology: Gumshoos inhabits urban and rural environments. This is a diurnal Pokémon. They generally like to wonder around. They also live in families. It feeds on smaller Pokémon.

Name: Grubbin
Ecology: Grubbin are commonly found in forests and power plants, where they feed on electricity by latching onto trees and other electrical sources with their mandibles. They are solitary creatures and not aggressive, spending their time consuming electricity for energy, with a calm personality.

Name: Charjabug
Ecology: Charjabug are found in similar habitats as Grubbin, particularly near power plants and forests, acting as living batteries. They live in groups to provide a consistent source of energy for a Vikavolt that may evolve from one in the group, with a helpful personality.

Name: Vikavolt
Ecology: Vikavolt are aerial predators commonly found in forests and near power plants. They have a solitary lifestyle, preying on smaller bug Pokémon and other insects, with a very aggressive personality.

Name: Crabrawler
Ecology: Crabrawler lives near human settlements in urban areas or in beachy environments. They typically live solitary lives.  Their diet consists of berries and seeds and they fight frequently with other Crabrawler over food and territory, leading to a headstrong and stubborn personality.

Name: Crabominable
Ecology: Crabominable tend to live on Snowy peaks and mountain tops. Their diets consist mostly of plant matter found at high altitude. They are mostly solitary pokemon. They have aggressive and tough personalities, with little regard for safety.

Name: Oricorio-baile
Ecology: Oricorio-baile are most commonly found living in cities, but have also been seen in some grasslands and forests. They are active during the day, and dance erratically.  Oricorio Baile gather energy from flowers and berries.  They live in flocks and are fiercely loyal to their flocks, and they have outgoing and charismatic personalities.

Name: Cutiefly
Ecology: Cutiefly habitats are fields and meadows, especially near flowering plants as they need pollen and nectar. They feed by using their long proboscis to gather pollen and nectar from flowers, and are often seen flitting around gardens. Their primary activities include foraging for food and creating nurseries for larva. They are often seen working in large groups.

Name: Ribombee
Ecology: Ribombee are found around forests, fields, and meadows near flowering plants, eating Pollen and Nectar from flowers.  Ribombee live together, and create nests for themselves and their larva, they spend their time keeping nests maintained and gathering resources to keep them maintained.

Name: Rockruff
Ecology: Rockruff live in rough terrain, rocky areas and mountainous regions with steep cliffs and rugged landscapes. Rockruff typically lives in small packs. It feeds on small insects, berries, and other small amounts of foods that can be found in their habitats.

Name: Lycanroc-midday
Ecology: Lycanroc-midday primarily inhabits rocky mountains. These Pokemon are largely solitary, and are only found around their mate. They feast on smaller Pokemon and scavenge carcasses for nourishment.

Name: Wishiwashi-solo
Ecology: Wishiwashi-solo are commonly found in shallow waters near coral reefs, and live in massive schools, capable of being one large pokemon known as Wishiwashi-school form. Their primary diet consists of small fish and plant matter, they have wary and cautious personalities.

Name: Mareanie
Ecology: Mareanie prefers coastal regions and underwater caves, often found in proximity to Corsola, which it preys upon, their diet consists solely of Corsola and its branches. They live solitary lives, and tend to be independent pokemon, and have vicious and violent personalities.

Name: Toxapex
Ecology: Toxapex are found primarily in underwater caves, near coastal regions in proximity to Corsola, hunting for food. Their diet consists entirely of corsola, similar to Mareanie. They are typically solitary and cautious, they exhibit a highly protective attitude towards their territory.

Name: Mudbray
Ecology: Mudbray are commonly found in grasslands and fields. They are very social, living in groups. Their diet consists of grasses and various grains.

Name: Mudsdale
Ecology: Mudsdale are usually found on plains, often farms as their kind nature is helpful. They are docile Pokémon that will carry anything in their place, helping trainers who are carrying cargo. They tend to live solitary lives, only mingling with mudbray.

Name: Dewpider
Ecology: Dewpider are commonly found near bodies of fresh water. They create a bubble of water around their head to both protect themselves and to carry water to drier areas. They are solitary creatures, preferring to hunt alone, feeding on small insects and plant matter.

Name: Araquanid
Ecology: Araquanid are found near ponds and lakes, preying on unsuspecting Pokémon by drawing them into their water bubble and drowning them.  They are solitary hunters with a fierce temperament, often seen competing with other Araquanid for territory.

Name: Fomantis
Ecology: Fomantis are nocturnal Pokémon that spend their days soaking up sunlight.  They live in grassy areas and forests, absorbing nutrients through their leaves.  They are solitary and vulnerable, mimicking plant life for protection and preferring direct sunlight and avoiding movement to maximize energy storage.

Name: Lurantis
Ecology: Lurantis live in grassy fields and forests, using their colorful appearance to attract prey, which consists of smaller Pokémon. They are solitary hunters with a refined demeanor, spending hours maintaining their appearance. They can be fiercely protective of their territory, engaging in battles to defend their resources.

Name: Morelull
Ecology: Morelull are found in dark forests, using their glowing spores to communicate with each other. They gather in groups near trees, sharing nutrients. They have a symbiotic relationship with the surrounding plant life, using the forests nutrient supplies to glow which causes other flora to also grow better.

Name: Shiinotic
Ecology: Shiinotic are found in deep forests and use their spores to control and confuse other Pokémon.  They live in small groups, acting as guardians of their territory. These pokemon are a part of local ghost stories told among humans living near these forests. They also have a symbiotic relationship with the surrounding plant life, draining the nutrients from other flora causing surrounding flora to wilt.

Name: Salandit
Ecology: Salandit live in volcanic regions and caves, feeding on sulfur and other minerals. They form social hierarchies where the female Salandit is dominant and males must bring her food. They are often seen alone and prefer volcanic rock formations that offer an extra layer of protection and the unique properties from minerals found within that rock.

Name: Salazzle
Ecology: Salazzle live in volcanic regions and caves.  They live in a harem of male Salandit who bring them food. As queens they often do not have to work for sustenance and have been found resting and bathing in pools of warm lava.

Name: Stufful
Ecology: Stufful live in forests and mountains. They gather food which consists of fruit, but they hate being touched. They can be seen alone, hugging tree trunks, or occasionally traveling in small groups when looking for food.

Name: Bewear
Ecology: Bewear live in forests and mountains, similar to Stufful.  They feed on Berries, but are immensely strong.  They are solitary creatures that tend to hunt alone. These pokemon have been known to have accidental deadly hugs of friendship toward trainers.

Name: Bounsweet
Ecology: Bounsweet are often found in orchards. The sweet scent produced by these pokemon makes them irresistibly tasty. They are solitary creatures that travel the tropics with ease. They are social but tend to run away when they get into danger.

Name: Steenee
Ecology: Steenee are found in tropical forests, being social but mischievous in nature. Steenee enjoy playing pranks. When fleeing they also enjoy moving in large groups or numbers.

Name: Tsareena
Ecology: Tsareena live in dense jungles and lead groups of Steenee. They punish any Pokemon that intrudes onto its home space. The victors are at times turned to servants.  She acts as a leader with absolute power.

Name: Comfey
Ecology: Comfey are social Pokémon found on tropical islands. They love to gather flowers and create floral rings which it then gives as presents to its friends and allies.

Name: Oranguru
Ecology: Oranguru live in forests and mountains, and they are known for their intelligence and wisdom. They prefer to live solitary lives in trees deep within the forest. It is known to take on human-like qualities such as sipping tea.

Name: Passimian
Ecology: Passimian live in troops of around 20-30 individuals. They are highly social and cooperate with each other. These Pokémon are known for their exceptional teamwork and leadership abilities, often training rigorously to improve their skills. Passimian have a strict hierarchy and communicate through a complex system of gestures and calls.

Name: Wimpod
Ecology: Wimpod are solitary creatures that inhabit beaches and rocky coastlines. They are timid and skittish, scurrying away at the slightest sign of danger. Their diet consists of decaying seaweed and other organic matter. Wimpod are not known for their social behavior, preferring to live alone and avoid confrontation.

Name: Golisopod
Ecology: Golisopod are formidable predators that inhabit underwater caves and rocky crevices. They are solitary creatures and fiercely territorial, attacking any intruders that venture into their domain. Their diet consists of fish, crustaceans, and other marine animals. Golisopod are known for their ruthless efficiency and unwavering determination.

Name: Sandygast
Ecology: Sandygast are born from grudges that have sunk into the sand of the beach. They inhabit beaches and coastlines, where they blend in with the sand. They feed on the life force of other creatures, burying their prey and slowly draining their energy. Sandygast are solitary creatures, often seen as eerie and mysterious.

Name: Palossand
Ecology: Palossand are large, imposing Pokémon that inhabit beaches and coastal areas. They are territorial and will attack any intruders that come too close to their sandcastle. Palossand can control sand and create powerful whirlpools to ensnare their prey. They feed on the life force of other Pokémon, burying them alive and draining their energy.

Name: Pyukumuku
Ecology: Pyukumuku are solitary creatures that inhabit shallow waters along beaches and coastlines. They are sedentary Pokémon that prefer to remain in one location, feeding on small invertebrates and organic matter. Pyukumuku have a unique defense mechanism, ejecting their internal organs to surprise predators and escape danger. These organs can regenerate later.

Name: Type-null
Ecology: Type-Null were artificially created Pokémon.  They were solitary and lived in a laboratory before running free. It's a largely docile Pokemon.

Name: Silvally
Ecology: Silvally, after breaking free, lives amongst other Pokémon. The can vary their type due to their unique capabilities. They have a synthetic body, but it's still that of a normal pokemon

Name: Minior-red-meteor
Ecology: Minior typically live in the ozone layer, feeding on any space-born debris. However, it will often fall to earth, in its meteor form and land wherever.

Name: Komala
Ecology: Komala, due to never being awake, can live basically anywhere.  While Komala appears in a lot of media to be living alone, it's because all their decisions are purely dictated by the log, which leads them to not stick in social groups.

Name: Turtonator
Ecology: Turtonator lives in the more secluded volcano areas of their native island. As such, it primarily eats volcanic rocks. They spend almost their whole life alone, only searching for a mate once a year.

Name: Togedemaru
Ecology: Togedemaru live across open grassy fields, and mountainous regions. This Pokemon are scavengers, consuming mostly seeds. It likes rolling around, which often causes other Pokemon to become annoyed

Name: Mimikyu-disguised
Ecology: Mimikyu often lives alone, under houses, because of their hatred of the sun. The food for the Pokemon varies, but it primarily relies on getting leftover scrapes.

Name: Bruxish
Ecology: Bruxish likes to live in shallow ocean areas. The main part of its diet is Shellder, but it will eat whatever swims into its area. Its loud noises act as a signal for where they should claim for territory.

Name: Drampa
Ecology: Drampa spends its time secluded high in the mountains. Since it loves children, it's typically the protector of any Pokemon with kids. They are herbivores, so its typical diet is berries and leaves.

Name: Dhelmise
Ecology: Dhelmise are solitary Pokémon that dwell in shipwrecks and other submerged structures. They are composed of seaweed and the wreckage of ships, which they use to ensnare and sink prey. They are aggressive hunters and fiercely territorial, often attacking any creature that intrudes upon their domain. Their diet primarily consists of seaweed and small aquatic creatures, although they have been known to consume larger prey if the opportunity arises.

Name: Jangmo-o
Ecology: Jangmo-o are solitary Pokémon that live in harsh, mountainous regions. They are highly independent and spend their days training to become stronger. Jangmo-o have a strong sense of honor and are willing to challenge any opponent, regardless of their size or strength. Their diet consists primarily of berries and other plant matter.

Name: Hakamo-o
Ecology: Hakamo-o are social Pokémon that live in packs in mountainous regions. They are highly competitive and constantly strive to improve their skills. Hakamo-o use their scales to communicate with one another, often engaging in ritualistic dances to display their strength and skill. Their diet consists primarily of berries, nuts, and small insects.

Name: Kommo-o
Ecology: Kommo-o are pack-oriented Pokémon that lead other Jangmo-o and Hakamo-o in training. They are very strong and honorable, and are dedicated to protecting their community and territory. Kommo-o typically live in caves located high in mountainous regions and spend their days training in martial arts. Their diet consists of berries, nuts, insects, and the occasional small mammal.

Name: Tapu-koko
Ecology: Tapu Koko is the guardian deity of Melemele Island. It's a solitary Pokémon with a capricious personality, known to appear suddenly and disappear just as quickly. It's highly protective of its island and is known to deliver fierce electric shocks to anyone it deems a threat. Tapu Koko is a curious Pokémon known to observe others and is a powerful electric-type. Its diet is unknown but can be inferred to be carnivorous.

Name: Tapu-lele
Ecology: Tapu Lele is the guardian deity of Akala Island. It's a benevolent and playful Pokémon that spreads scales that stimulate the body and heal injuries. However, it can be cruel, scattering its scales without regard for the recipient's well-being. Tapu Lele has a cheerful demeanor and is fueled by the energy of those around it. Its diet is unknown.

Name: Tapu-bulu
Ecology: Tapu Bulu is the guardian deity of Ula'ula Island. It is a laid-back and slow-moving Pokémon, but it possesses immense power. It dislikes unnecessary conflict and tends to seclude itself in forests, where it protects the local plant life and keeps other Pokémon in check. Tapu Bulu's diet mainly consists of plant matter.

Name: Tapu-fini
Ecology: Tapu Fini is the guardian deity of Poni Island. It's known to be reclusive, preferring to spend its time in solitude near bodies of water. It has the power to create special water that can purify those who are touched by it. Tapu Fini despises those who do wrong and does not hesitate to unleash its wrath. The exacts of its diet are currently unknown.

Name: Cosmog
Ecology: Cosmog are incredibly rare Pokémon that float in the air like dust. They are gentle and innocent Pokémon that absorb light to grow. Their diet and exact habitat are unknown.

Name: Cosmoem
Ecology: Cosmoem is an extremely rare Pokémon encased in a solid, unmoving shell. It absorbs vast quantities of light and dust.  It remains completely still and nearly impossible to move. Their diet and exact habitat are unknown.

Name: Solgaleo
Ecology: Solgaleo is said to live in another world and is known to be a Pokémon that controls solar energy. It is associated with the sun and embodies its power. It is a noble Pokémon that radiates light and warmth, and is protective of its companions. Its diet is currently unknown.

Name: Lunala
Ecology: Lunala is said to live in another world and is known to be a Pokémon that controls lunar energy. It is associated with the moon and embodies its mysterious nature. It is a gentle Pokémon that is said to guide lost souls and can create wormholes through which it travels. Its diet is currently unknown.

Name: Nihilego
Ecology: Nihilego is an Ultra Beast that behaves like a parasite, latching onto hosts and stimulating their abilities while sapping their will. They are often found near areas where Ultra Wormholes open, though their natural habitat is unknown. Their diet isn't defined; however, they appear to require the energy and compounds provided by other lifeforms.

Name: Buzzwole
Ecology: Buzzwole is an Ultra Beast known for its massive, muscular body. It is an extremely aggressive Pokemon that shows off its muscles, considered a threat to anything and everything. Buzzwole is speculated to obtain nutrients from the consumption of organic materials. Its natural habitat isn't specified, but it is thought to have been transported through Ultra Wormholes.

Name: Pheromosa
Ecology: Pheromosa is an Ultra Beast known for its incredible speed and beauty. It is incredibly agile and repelled by filth of any sort. It is considered a threat to anything and everything due to its wild tendencies and habits. Phermosa's origin and natural habitat are also unknown, but its diet is currently unknown.

Name: Xurkitree
Ecology: Xurkitree are commonly found in power plants and areas with high electrical activity. They sustain themselves by absorbing electricity from their surroundings, often overloading power grids and causing blackouts. They are solitary creatures and do not exhibit complex social behaviors.  Their personality is often described as erratic and unpredictable.

Name: Celesteela
Ecology: Celesteela inhabit forests near sources of geothermal energy, using the heat to aid in their growth.  They feed on minerals absorbed from the soil through their root-like structures. They are solitary Pokémon. Celesteela are generally calm but will fiercely defend their territory.

Name: Kartana
Ecology: Kartana are found in bamboo forests and similar habitats, feeding on plant matter. They are solitary hunters, slicing through foliage with their sharp bodies to find prey. They are generally considered to be aloof and emotionless.

Name: Guzzlord
Ecology: Guzzlord are found in desolate, trash-filled environments.  They consume anything and everything, including garbage, toxic waste, and even entire buildings, with seemingly no ill effects. They are solitary creatures and highly territorial, and they have voracious appetites and aggressive demeanors.

Name: Necrozma
Ecology: Necrozma once lived among humans as an ally in the ancient times. While their natural habitats vary between dimensions, they all now have an almost endless thirst for light.  It behaves in an agonized manner, as if eternally in pain.

Name: Magearna
Ecology: Magearna live among civilized communities in quiet, serene areas.  They consume energy from the atmosphere and from the happiness of others. They are solitary but happily engage with people in need. They are known for their compassionate and caring personalities.

Name: Marshadow
Ecology: Marshadow reside in the shadows of strong trainers. They consume the life-force of the trainer. Marshadow lurks in darkness, copying the movements and powers of others. When the time is right it unleashes its explosive might. Marshadow can be described as reclusive.

Name: Poipole
Ecology: Poipole inhabit other dimensions but can travel through Ultra Wormholes to our world. They prefer barren environments and consume unknown substances. Poipole often live together in large colonies. Poipole is known for its playful and curious nature, often spraying trainers with a strange fluid.

Name: Naganadel
Ecology: Naganadel are native to Ultra Space, where they live in colonies ruled by a Queen. These colonies connect to other world using Ultra Wormholes, and usually reside around these openings. Naganadel are known to secrete poisonous fluid from the large needle on its abdomen. This fluid is known to be able to cripple those exposed to it. Naganadel has a very caring personality, and is loyal to it's colony.

Name: Stakataka
Ecology: Stakataka inhabit rocky terrains and ancient ruins.  They primarily consume minerals from the environment, maintaining their structure. Stakataka live in groups. They have stoic and fortress-like personalities.

Name: Blacephalon
Ecology: Blacephalon are found in environments with celebrations and performances, using this chance to surprise and confuse targets. They are predators and feed on the life-force of surprised organisms, especially those startled by their explosive attacks. They are solitary and exhibit erratic, clownish behaviors.

Name: Zeraora
Ecology: Zeraora lives in dense forests and mountainous regions, using electricity to enhance its speed and agility.  It sustains itself by absorbing electricity from thunderstorms, often seeking out areas with frequent lightning strikes. Zeraora live solitary lives. They exhibit wild and untamed personalities.

Name: Meltan
Ecology: Meltan appear in areas where metal and energy converge, consuming rust and metallic byproducts. They are thought to reproduce asexually by attaching to larger metal objects and absorbing metal. It lives in packs.

Name: Melmetal
Ecology: Melmetal appears near power plants and areas with metal ore to consume rust. It gathers other Meltan to create a larger community in an attempt to become bigger. Its personality is similar to a friendly guardian.

Name: Grookey
Ecology: Grookey lives in packs near dense forested areas. They have a generally docile personality and enjoy causing mischief.

Name: Thwackey
Ecology: Thwackey are known for their energetic and playful nature. They reside in dense forests, often drumming rhythmically on trees to communicate with one another and mark their territory. They primarily feed on berries and nuts, enjoying the lush vegetation of their habitat. They live in groups. These Pokémon can become easily frustrated if their rhythm is disrupted.

Name: Rillaboom
Ecology: Rillaboom live in forests and are known to be very territorial. They eat fruit and plant material. They live in groups and create drumming circles in forests, and maintain the order.  It is extremely protective of its allies, and the sounds of its drumming can trigger a primal instinct that makes its allies want to fight.

Name: Scorbunny
Ecology: Scorbunny's natural habitat is grassy plains and fields. They are active and energetic, spending their days honing their powerful kicks and practicing fire-based attacks. They primarily feed on berries and other vegetation.  Scorbunny tend to live alone. They are known for being hot-blooded and reckless.

Name: Raboot
Ecology: Raboot live in warmer regions and are often seen near volcanic areas. They use their fire-based attacks to heat themselves and their surroundings. They tend to be solitary.  It's behavior is believed to be influenced by a special hormone that it generates. This species demonstrates a rebellious nature.

Name: Cinderace
Ecology: Cinderace live in plains and fields, but will take shelter in urban locations during cold or wet weather. They can be found in groups or on their own. They have exceptional athleticism, allowing them to deliver powerful kicks and use fire-based moves with grace and precision. They primarily feed on vegetation.

Name: Sobble
Ecology: Sobble live near bodies of water and in wetlands. They are timid creatures and when threatened, will turn invisible by camouflaging in the water around them. When scared, it will shed tears that have the effect of 100 onions. They are primarily solitary Pokémon that like to spend the majority of the day hidden underwater.

Name: Drizzile
Ecology: Drizzile inhabit damp forests and caves. Drizzile are solitary creatures known for their melancholic nature and introverted personalities. It uses its stealth and intelligence to protect itself and its territory from threats, often hiding and observing from the shadows.

Name: Inteleon
Ecology: Inteleon habitat lies within rocky outcrops by bodies of water and wetlands.  They are exceptionally intelligent and are skilled strategists, using their environment and their natural abilities to their advantage in battles.  Inteleon tend to live in solitude. This Pokemon is the most intellegent Pokemon in the Galar region.

Name: Skwovet
Ecology: Skwovet can be found wherever food can be found. As such, they thrive in urban, as well as forest, environments.  They carry berries and other food items in their cheek pouches. Skwovet live alone and can be found eating nuts, berries, and seeds.

Name: Greedent
Ecology: Greedent are native to the Galar region and live wherever food can be found. They love to hoard food. They live alone and defend the stashes. They eat nuts and berries.

Name: Rookidee
Ecology: Rookidee can be found in forests and cities, demonstrating adaptability to diverse environments.  These Pokemon like to prove their courage. Rookidee tend to live in flocks where they eat small bug Pokemon.

Name: Corvisquire
Ecology: Corvisquire are found in a range of habitats, including cities and forests.  They are intelligent Pokémon, but also known to be somewhat vain, often preening their feathers. Corvisquire often live in small groups that feast on the deceased.

Name: Corviknight
Ecology: Corviknight lives mostly in highly urbanised environments in Galar and operate a Flying Taxi service for people and Pokemon who can't fly for themselves. These raven Pokemon have steel armor, making it the most powerful flying type Pokemon. These birds tend to live in flocks that feed on smaller Pokemon.

Name: Blipbug
Ecology: Blipbug is a very weak Pokémon. These tiny Bug types hide in foliage in meadows. When danger is near, it hides by remaining motionless.

Name: Dottler
Ecology: Dottler typically live in forests. When evolving from Blipbug it stops moving to keep energy to evolve and only uses psychic abilities. To use its psychic abilities it covers its body with moss to prevent detection.

Name: Orbeetle
Ecology: Orbeetle is commonly found in forests and plains. It is a herbivore, feeding on various plants and flowers. It is a social Pokémon, living in colonies with a hive mind. Orbeetle are known for being intelligent and strategic.

Name: Nickit
Ecology: Nickit typically inhabits urban areas. Its diet consists of anything it can scavenge, being an omnivore. It is commonly found solitary. They are cunning and sneaky.

Name: Thievul
Ecology: Thievul are nocturnal and inhabit urban and forest environments. They are opportunistic omnivores, eating both plants and small animals. It is commonly found solitary. Thievul are known to be crafty and manipulative.

Name: Gossifleur
Ecology: Gossifleur is usually found in grassy fields and meadows. It is a herbivore and consumes nectar and pollen from flowers. It lives solitarily. Gossifleur are gentle and prefer to avoid conflict.

Name: Eldegoss
Ecology: Eldegoss prefers to live in grassy areas and meadows. This Pokémon feeds on sunlight and nutrients in the air through its cotton-like spores, making it a unique type of herbivore. They tend to live in small groups for protection. They are gentle and kind.

Name: Wooloo
Ecology: Wooloo are commonly found on farms and in pastures. This Pokémon is a herbivore and grazes on grass and other vegetation. They are social, living in flocks with a close-knit social structure. Wooloo are known to be gentle and docile, often getting scared easily.

Name: Dubwool
Ecology: Dubwool are typically found in mountainous and hilly regions. They are herbivores that feed on grass and hardy plants. They live in herds. Dubwool are calm and dependable. They are protective of their Wooloo.

Name: Chewtle
Ecology: Chewtle can be found in rivers and lakes. This Pokémon is an omnivore, feeding on both aquatic plants and small fish. Solitary Pokémon. Chewtle are known to be playful and curious, but they can also be stubborn.

Name: Drednaw
Ecology: Drednaw resides in rivers, lakes, and coastal areas. Drednaw is an omnivore, preying on fish, smaller Pokémon, and aquatic vegetation. Typically solitary Pokémon. Drednaw is aggressive and territorial.

Name: Yamper
Ecology: Yamper is often found on farms and in grasslands. It is an omnivore. Yamper lives in packs. Yamper are known for being energetic and friendly.

Name: Boltund
Ecology: Boltund is commonly found in plains and open fields. It is an omnivore. Boltund typically roams with a pack of Yamper. Boltund are known for being loyal and protective of their trainer.

Name: Rolycoly
Ecology: Rolycoly is often found in coal mines and caves. They consume coal as their primary food source, and are usually found solitary. Rolycoly are often shy and curious. They can also be easily startled.

Name: Carkol
Ecology: Carkol resides in mines and underground tunnels. This Pokémon is an herbivore. Carkol usually live solitary. Carkol are gentle giants that act as protectors.

Name: Coalossal
Ecology: Coalossal lives near coal mines and volcanoes. Coalossal is an herbivore. They are mostly solitary and do not interact with others. They are usually described as protective of their young and other smaller pokemon.

Name: Applin
Ecology: Applin is often found in apple orchards and forests. Applin is a herbivore, eating the insides of apples. They are usually solitary. Applin are gentle creatures. They avoid conflict.

Name: Flapple
Ecology: Flapple inhabits orchards and meadows, where it feeds on apples. It is solitary, often hiding in apple trees and ambushing unsuspecting prey with its sticky saliva.

Name: Appletun
Ecology: Appletun is found in orchards and grassy plains, where it grazes on sweet apples. It is a social creature, often found in small herds. Appletun are gentle and docile, often sharing their apples with other Pokémon.

Name: Silicobra
Ecology: Silicobra lives in arid deserts, burrowing under the sand to stay cool and ambush prey. It is a solitary creature, fiercely protective of its territory. It primarily consumes small rodents and insects.

Name: Sandaconda
Ecology: Sandaconda dwells in harsh desert environments, creating massive sand tombs to trap prey. It is generally solitary, but may gather in groups during breeding season. Sandaconda consume larger prey such as desert-dwelling Pokémon and small mammals.

Name: Cramorant
Ecology: Cramorant frequents coastal areas and bodies of water, diving underwater to catch fish. It is a social Pokémon, often seen in flocks. Cramorant possesses a unique hunting method where it regurgitates its caught prey.

Name: Arrokuda
Ecology: Arrokuda lives in fast-flowing rivers and streams, using its streamlined body to dart after prey. It is a solitary hunter, preying on smaller fish and aquatic insects. Arrokuda is known for its incredible speed and agility in the water.

Name: Barraskewda
Ecology: Barraskewda inhabits deep waters, preying on fish. This pokemon is solitary

Name: Toxel
Ecology: Toxel is a mischievous Pokemon living in nurseries and urban environments. Toxel lives alone, and has an electric/poisonous biology.

Name: Toxtricity-amped
Ecology: Toxtricity live in human settlements and punk shows. These energetic Pokemon love being surrounded by noise and people

Name: Sizzlipede
Ecology: Sizzlipede lives under houses, because they are dark, warm and moist. These territorial pokemon are solitary creatures, and can be a huge hazard around wooden houses

Name: Centiskorch
Ecology: Centiskorch make their nests near active volcanoes and hot springs. They are aggressive and protective of their territory, solitary animals

Name: Clobbopus
Ecology: Clobbopus inhabit rocky coastlines and tidal pools. These pokemon love showing off how they can tangle things

Name: Grapploct
Ecology: Grapploct lives in deep oceans. This pokemon has the instinct of a martial artist, using every part of its body in combat.

Name: Sinistea
Ecology: Sinistea are found in old ruins and abandoned houses, infesting teacups with their ghostly essence. This pokemon doesn't form any group because they need to keep moving if they want to survive

Name: Polteageist
Ecology: Polteageist inhabit old ruins and abandoned buildings, seeking out suitable teapots to reside in. They are mischievous and solitary.

Name: Hatenna
Ecology: Hatenna are solitary Pokémon that inhabit forests and meadows. They have a strong aversion to strong emotions, especially anger and excitement, which they sense with the horn on their head. When they sense these emotions, they will flee to a quieter location. They are herbivores, feeding on berries and flowers.

Name: Hattrem
Ecology: Hattrem are solitary Pokémon that are found in quiet, wooded areas, away from areas with strong emotional outbursts. It is primarily nocturnal, spending the day resting in caves or hollow trees. Hattrem dislikes strong emotions and will silence those creating the disturbance by slamming them on the head. Hattrem is carnivorous and will feed on small insects and arachnids that they catch in the surrounding area.

Name: Hatterene
Ecology: Hatterene are solitary Pokémon that are found in secluded areas. They are very sensitive to strong emotions, and will attack anyone who disrupts their peace. Hatterene lives deep within forests, though can also be found near ancient ruins, drawing energy from residual magical traces and keeping away from modern society. Hatterene will remain still for long periods of time and feed on weak electrical waves.

Name: Impidimp
Ecology: Impidimp live in forests and caves, and are primarily nocturnal, preferring to hide in shadows during the day. They are mischievous and enjoy playing pranks on humans and other Pokémon. Impidimp are omnivorous, eating berries, nuts, and occasionally stealing food from people. They have a habit of latching onto larger Pokémon to hitchhike, often causing trouble for their unwitting hosts.

Name: Morgrem
Ecology: Morgrem are nocturnal Pokémon that inhabit dark forests and caves, acting as tricksters and scavengers. Morgrem are highly social, forming small gangs that cooperate to find food and cause mischief. They use their sharp claws to steal from others. They have an omnivorous diet consisting of berries, nuts, and occasionally meat scavenged from other Pokémon's kills.

Name: Grimmsnarl
Ecology: Grimmsnarl are found in forests, typically at night. They are aggressive and territorial, often attacking anything that enters their domain. They are skilled at manipulating their hair to ensnare and restrain opponents. Grimmsnarl are primarily carnivorous, hunting smaller Pokémon, and known to cause trouble to any intruders in their territory.

Name: Obstagoon
Ecology: Obstagoon live in groups, often forming gangs. These Pokémon are commonly found in urban areas and forests, acting as protectors for Zigzagoon and Linoone. They are highly territorial and will defend their turf fiercely. Obstagoon are omnivorous and hunt cooperatively in order to catch their prey. They are known for their signature defensive posture, where they cross their arms and taunt opponents, before striking with powerful blows.

Name: Perrserker
Ecology: Perrserker are typically found in coastal regions. These social Pokémon live in groups. They are fiercely territorial and will attack anyone who approaches their territory. Perrserker primarily feed on shellfish and other aquatic creatures, using their metallic claws to crush the shells. They will often be found raiding fishing boats.

Name: Cursola
Ecology: Cursola are typically found near polluted ocean waters, particularly around coral reefs that have been bleached due to environmental damage. Cursola are solitary Pokémon that are constantly suffering, due to being remnants of shattered coral that once lived in the sea. They absorb moonlight to maintain their spectral form, but are weakened by strong sunlight.

Name: Sirfetchd
Ecology: Sirfetch'd lives in grassy plains and wetlands. Sirfetch'd are honorable and chivalrous fighters, fiercely protecting their leek stalk, which they use as both a weapon and a source of food. They are solitary Pokémon that live alongside other Farfetch'd until they have trained long enough, when they then evolve. Sirfetch'd's diet consists of seeds, berries, and small insects.

Name: Mr-rime
Ecology: Mr. Rime inhabit snowy environments. They are known for their sophisticated dance-like movements. Mr. Rime are social and tend to live in groups. They communicate with each other using rhythmic steps and gestures, and they enjoy performing on ice. The ecology of Mr. Rime involves a mixed diet of berries, seeds, and nuts gathered from the surrounding environment.

Name: Runerigus
Ecology: Runerigus can be found haunting ancient ruins and desolate landscapes. These Pokémon are created when a Yamask bonds with a cursed stone tablet. Runerigus are territorial and will attack anyone who disturbs their territory. They are said to feed on the energy of those who touch the cursed tablet. Their diet is unknown, though believed to be spiritual energy.

Name: Milcery
Ecology: Milcery primarily live in pastures, meadows, and farms, coexisting harmoniously with humans and other Pokémon. They are attracted to sweet smells and are often found near bakeries and patisseries, where they enjoy consuming spilled sweets. Milcery are docile and gentle creatures and are easily cared for.

Name: Alcremie
Ecology: Alcremie primarily live in pastures, meadows, and farms, coexisting harmoniously with humans and other Pokémon. They are attracted to sweet smells and are often found near bakeries and patisseries, where they feed upon sweets and any available treats. Alcremie are gentle creatures who happily share their sweetness with others.

Name: Falinks
Ecology: Falinks live in mountainous regions. These Pokémon live and operate as a single unit, exhibiting coordinated movements. They are territorial and fiercely protect their territory, acting as a large group. Falinks have an omnivorous diet that mainly consists of berries and smaller Pokémon. They hunt in packs and their teamwork allows them to take on larger threats.

Name: Pincurchin
Ecology: Pincurchin typically live in groups along the ocean floor, camouflaged amongst seaweed and rocks. They feed on algae and small invertebrates. They are solitary and territorial, defending their patch of the seafloor with their electrically charged spines. Their personality is generally cautious and defensive.

Name: Snom
Ecology: Snom live in cold, snowy environments, often found clinging to trees or hiding under large leaves for warmth. They feed on snow and ice. They are solitary creatures and have a shy personality, often curling up into a ball when threatened.

Name: Frosmoth
Ecology: Frosmoth are found in cold, mountainous regions, typically near glaciers or snowy peaks. They feed on the energy from moonlight and starlight. They are solitary Pokémon, fluttering gracefully through the night sky. Frosmoth have a calm and serene demeanor.

Name: Stonjourner
Ecology: Stonjourner are found in arid, rocky terrains, often standing in groups resembling ancient stone circles. They feed on minerals and solar energy. These Pokémon are social, often seen standing together in silent contemplation. Stonjourner are known for their stoic and patient nature.

Name: Eiscue-ice
Ecology: Eiscue-ice live in icy environments, typically found near the coastline. Their ice face protects them from the cold and allows them to survive in harsh conditions. They feed on fish and other marine life. They are often found alone. Eiscue-ice is often carefree and playful.

Name: Indeedee-male
Ecology: Indeedee-male typically reside in urban or suburban settings, where they serve as assistants and companions to humans. They feed on psychic energy emitted by people and Pokémon. Indeedee-male form small social groups. Their personality is loyal and diligent, always striving to meet the needs of their companions.

Name: Morpeko-full-belly
Ecology: Morpeko-full-belly lives in forests and caves, constantly searching for food to satisfy its enormous appetite. It feeds on berries and seeds, storing them in its cheek pouches. It has a solitary nature, frantically scavenging for resources. Morpeko-full-belly has an erratic personality, alternating between joy and desperation.

Name: Cufant
Ecology: Cufant live in mountainous regions, often near mines or industrial areas where they assist with heavy lifting. They feed on metal ores, which strengthen their bodies. Cufant form small herds, working together to transport materials. Their personality is diligent and hardworking, always eager to lend a helping trunk.

Name: Copperajah
Ecology: Copperajah inhabit mountainous and industrial regions. They are used for heavy lifting and construction. They eat metal ore to strengthen their bodies. They are social creatures. Copperajah are known for their strength and endurance.

Name: Dracozolt
Ecology: Dracozolt is an extinct Pokémon, resurrected from fossilized remains. It likely inhabited open plains and grasslands. Its diet consisted of plants and small animals, but it may have struggled to adapt to its environment. Dracozolt is thought to have been a solitary Pokémon. Its personality may have been confused and disoriented due to its resurrection.

Name: Arctozolt
Ecology: Arctozolt is an extinct Pokémon, resurrected from fossilized remains. It likely inhabited icy regions. Its diet consisted of fish and aquatic creatures, but it was not well-suited for swimming. Arctozolt is thought to have been a solitary Pokémon. Its personality may have been clumsy and awkward.

Name: Dracovish
Ecology: Dracovish is an extinct Pokémon, resurrected from fossilized remains. It likely inhabited bodies of water. Its diet consisted of anything it could fit into its mouth. Dracovish is thought to have been a solitary Pokémon. Its personality is brutal and greedy, attacking anything it sees.

Name: Arctovish
Ecology: Arctovish is an extinct Pokémon, resurrected from fossilized remains. It likely inhabited icy regions of the sea. It is carnivorous. Arctovish is a solitary Pokémon. It has a timid and awkward personality, struggling to breathe on land.

Name: Duraludon
Ecology: Duraludon live in caves. They are very solitary Pokémon. It is rumored that the Pokémon eat certain metallic ores that help grow the metal-like coating. It is a docile and peaceful creature that coexists with the ecosystem around it without any hostility.

Name: Dreepy
Ecology: Dreepy lives in forests and caves near water sources. Dreepy is believed to guide lost souls to the afterlife with its lantern. The Dreepy do not socialize unless approached by larger Pokemon to protect from predators. They can be quite aggressive if disturbed by intruders, protecting the sanctity of their forest.

Name: Drakloak
Ecology: Drakloak are solitary Pokémon that inhabit caves and forests. They are known to carry Dreepy, their pre-evolution, on their heads and care for them until they evolve into Drakloak. They are carnivorous, feeding on small Pokémon and insects.

Name: Dragapult
Ecology: Dragapult is a dual-type Dragon/Ghost Pokémon. It is a solitary Pokémon that lives in caves and forests. Dragapult are known for their incredible speed and are skilled hunters. They fire Dreepy like missiles. Its diet consists primarily of other Pokémon and various plant types from forests.

Name: Zacian
Ecology: Zacian are Legendary Pokémon of the Galar region. It is a Fairy-type Pokémon. It lives in forests and is solitary. It is a skilled swordfighter and is known for its bravery. It hunts primarily for other smaller fairy type pokemon, but will occasionally eat berries if needed.

Name: Zamazenta
Ecology: Zamazenta are Legendary Pokémon of the Galar region. It is a Fighting-type Pokémon. They live in forests and are solitary. Zamazenta are known for its powerful shield. They primarily eat fighting and rock type berries found in the Galar Region. It will occasionally hunt to protect other wildlife.

Name: Eternatus
Ecology: Eternatus is a Poison/Dragon-type Legendary Pokémon. It lives in contaminated areas and is solitary. Eternatus absorbs energy from the environment. Its diet consists of energy from the earth's core, and it has been known to feed off other pokemon in desperate times.

Name: Kubfu
Ecology: Kubfu are solitary Pokémon that inhabit mountainous regions. They train rigorously to perfect their fighting skills. They are omnivorous, feeding on berries, nuts, and occasionally small Pokémon.

Name: Urshifu-single-strike
Ecology: Urshifu are solitary Pokémon that inhabit mountainous regions. The Single Strike Style Urshifu are fierce and determined fighters. Their diet consists primarily of fighting-type berries and nuts, supplemented with prey such as small Pokémon and insects.

Name: Zarude
Ecology: Zarude are solitary Pokémon that inhabit dense forests. They are known for their aggressive behavior and territorial nature. Zarude are omnivorous, feeding on fruits, nuts, insects, and small Pokémon.

Name: Regieleki
Ecology: Regieleki are solitary Pokémon that inhabit electrical power plants. They are known for their extreme speed and electrical abilities. Regieleki subsist solely on electricity, absorbing it from their surroundings.

Name: Regidrago
Ecology: Regidrago are solitary Pokémon that inhabit abandoned temples. They are known for their powerful Dragon-type attacks. Regidrago are carnivorous, preying on small Dragon-type Pokémon and other creatures.

Name: Glastrier
Ecology: Glastrier are solitary Pokémon that inhabit snowy mountain peaks. They are known for their immense strength and resilience to cold temperatures. Glastrier are herbivorous, feeding on tough, frozen plants and shrubs.

Name: Spectrier
Ecology: Spectrier are solitary Pokémon that inhabit haunted forests and ruins. They are known for their ethereal presence and spectral powers. Spectrier are carnivorous, feeding on the life force of other Pokémon.

Name: Calyrex
Ecology: Calyrex are solitary Pokémon that inhabit forests and grasslands. They are known for their intelligence and psychic abilities. Calyrex are herbivorous, feeding on grass and leaves.

Name: Wyrdeer
Ecology: Wyrdeer live in small herds in snowy regions. They are primarily herbivores, feeding on grass and roots. They are gentle Pokémon, often helping humans in need.

Name: Kleavor
Ecology: Kleavor live solitary lives in forests and rocky areas. They are carnivorous Pokémon and are known for their aggressive behavior and sharp rock-like axes that have grown on their arms. These axes are formed as a result of mineral consumption when this mantis-like pokemon evolves.

Name: Ursaluna
Ecology: Ursaluna, the Peat Pokémon, inhabits swampy wetlands and peat bogs, carving out territory for itself. It is a solitary creature, using its powerful forelegs to excavate peat, which it mixes with berries and nuts to create nutritious mud balls. Ursaluna has a gruff personality and is fiercely protective of its territory, warding off intruders with intimidating roars.

Name: Basculegion-male
Ecology: Basculegion are ghost-like fish, living in the rivers of Hisui. Schools of Basculegion will often charge into rapids, challenging other schools for fishing rights. Its diet consist of small water bugs and krill, filtered by the fringes on its fins. Their common personality trait is aggression towards other Basculegion

Name: Sneasler
Ecology: Sneasler is a skilled climber and forager that live high in the mountains, often in rocky cliffs. This Pokémon travels solo, and seeks berries and eggs which is their food. When it spots a meal, Sneasler turns very aggressive.

Name: Overqwil
Ecology: Overqwil lurks in dark undersea caves, solitary piscines with barbs that are venomous. Its diet includes other sea dwelling Pokemon, especially smaller Water-type Pokemon. Overqwil tend to act lonely.

Name: Enamorus-incarnate
Ecology: Enamorus frequents open fields and coastal areas, known to live in herds while feeding off nectar and pollen from flowers. These pokemon, even though Legendary, are very carefree.
